arbeitnow-celonis-senior-application-pro.title: Senior Application Product Manager - Supply Chain - Procurement
arbeitnow-celonis-senior-application-pro.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Celonis Business Apps Supply Chain team is an innovative group of product and technology enthusiasts focused on creating and deploying next-generation solutions in the Supply Chain domain. We are transforming how enterprise solutions are built driven by our customers' business critical problems. Our team strikes an ideal balance between deep technical execution (including advanced data engineering and AI tooling) and a sharp customer focus to create highly impactful products that accelerate value realization across our customer base.

The Role:

You will gain experience in the Supply Chain and related processes and act as the interface between customers, our Go-To-Market and our Product & Engineering teams, shaping the future of Celonis’ product offering in this domain. Take this chance to rethink the way companies run their Supply Chain processes, with a specific focus on Procurement and help our customers to accelerate their value realization with Celonis.

As an Application Product Manager for Procurement, you will operate at the intersection of customer-facing solution engineering and core product innovation to architect and deploy cutting-edge enterprise AI solutions. In this hybrid role, you will partner directly with strategic customers to build bespoke, composable procurement and supply chain architectures using the Celonis Context Model (CCM) and advanced decision intelligence. By leveraging modern AI tooling and LLM-based coding agents, you will abstract field insights into reusable semantic libraries, directly accelerating Celonis' global agentic deployment workflows. You get hands-on: prototyping on the platform, wiring up data, building AI-driven solutions, and iterating directly with the people who'll use them.

The work you’ll do:

Your mission is to make the vision of AI-powered solutions a reality by building products that turn the cutting edge capabilities of the Celonis  Platform from strategy into solutions that customers use to run their Procurement processes.

  • Discovery & Solution Blueprinting: Conduct collaborative discovery workshops to uncover root-causes and operational inefficiencies, mapping ambiguous customer needs into clear technical scopes and comprehensive solution blueprints.
  • Context Model & Solution Deployment: Execute hands-on deployments of customer-specific context models, data structures, and end-to-end supply chain blueprints within the Celonis platform.
  • Project Management & Customer Value: Own customer deployments end-to-end from initial kickoff to live production, presenting complex architectural solutions and strategic value narratives directly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive teams.
  • Prototype & Test Functions: Design, validate, and test use-case-specific decision intelligence functions, including e.g. optimization algorithms and predictive models.
  • Context Generation: Deconstruct monolithic application architectures and translate deployment learnings into reusable semantic entities and modular context libraries.

If you are passionate about Procurement, Supply Chain, the Celonis technology, and what it can do for our customers, here's your chance to directly contribute to taking our Celonis Platform and Context Model to the next level.

The qualifications you need:

  • 4+ years of experience as a Solution Engineer, Product Engineer, Technical Product Manager, Founding/Forward-Deployed Engineer, Implementation Consultant or a comparable technical, customer-facing role hybrid role.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core operational workflows in supply chain and procurement. You can speak the language of C-suite executives and seamlessly connect complex, systemic bottlenecks to strategic AI solutions.
  • A track record of building coherent solutions, not just isolated features. You think in terms of the whole solution and how the pieces fit together.
  • Expert in data analysis and data modeling including tools native to the Celonis platform: SQL, Python, quick to pick up new tools and platforms and able to prototype and build. Experience with platform-native tools like PQL is a significant asset.
  • Advanced architectural mastery of LLM orchestration, tool use/function calling, RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and agentic patterns for enterprise workflows.
  • Hands-on exposure to enterprise architectures, with ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle) or Material Requirements Planning (MRP) logic considered a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated project management capabilities accompanied by excellent planning and organizational skills.
  • Creativity in problem-solving, a solution-oriented mindset, and the ability to work autonomously while collaborating smoothly across multi-disciplinary squads.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the willingness to work very closely with customers and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English (knowledge of German is a plus).

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact — understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our team pairs deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As an intern, you will have the unique opportunity to learn and grow through hands-on experiences. Your role will involve utilizing our cutting-edge AI deployment tools to develop innovative solutions for our customers, together with more experienced Deployment Engineers.

This is not a traditional engineering role where you build everything manually. You will be introduced to AI-augmented and business-focused software delivery: helping specify what needs to be built, learning to direct AI agents to execute, and assisting in validating the results. Participation in team meetings and workshops will offer valuable insights into the decision-making process within the company.

Initiate and Connect

  • Conduct customer-facing sessions with experienced Deployment Engineers to discuss ongoing projects, translate strategic objectives into use cases, and receive guidance on best practices.
  • Assist in gathering and organizing relevant data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and consistency for analysis.

Build

  • Learn to direct AI deployment agents (like Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards by helping to write clear specifications.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis, utilizing Celonis and other tools to uncover trends, process inefficiencies, and root causes.
  • Assist in defining the initial solution design blueprint and configuring operational solutions across the platform.

Value & Rollout

  • Support the validation of AI-generated outputs for accuracy and business relevance alongside senior team members.
  • Help develop and maintain KPIs to track the success of project initiatives and quantify business impact.
  • Assist in documenting solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and customer handover.

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era

  • You will learn to work with AI agents as your primary tools, focusing on validating and refining their output rather than writing every line of code manually.
  • You will develop foundational specification and context engineering skills to help translate business needs into precise AI instructions.
  • As you navigate a fast-paced environment, you will learn how to adapt quickly to changes and new approaches as AI capabilities evolve.

The Qualifications You Need

arbeitnow-appinio-analytics-engineer-m-f.title: Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
arbeitnow-appinio-analytics-engineer-m-f.description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here

Your mission as an Analytics Engineer

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong data engineering skills to join our Data team and help build a scalable, reliable, and well-structured data foundation across Appinio.
In this role, you will design and maintain clean, scalable data models that make data easy to access, understand, and use across the organisation. You will use SQL, dbt, and Python to transform raw data into meaningful datasets, develop automated workflows, and ensure consistency and reliability across our data warehouse.
Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure.
Working closely with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and business teams, you will help define and standardise key business metrics such as revenue, bookings, and churn, ensuring a single source of truth across the company. You will also take ownership of data quality through automated testing, validation, and monitoring across the data lifecycle.
You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. You will also help prepare our data foundation for AI-driven analytics by ensuring that data models, business definitions, and documentation are structured, consistent, and accessible.
You will contribute to documentation, performance optimisation, and the continuous improvement of our data stack, helping us build a robust and scalable data platform that enables teams across Appinio to make faster, more informed decisions.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Data Modeling: Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models in the data warehouse using SQL and dbt, making data accessible and reliable for analysts and business users.
  • Data Transformation: Develop and maintain data transformation workflows, turning raw data from multiple sources into structured, analytics-ready datasets.
  • Data Pipelines & Integration: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliable data ingestion from APIs, databases, and third-party systems into the data warehouse.
  • Data Quality & Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by implementing automated tests, validations, monitoring, and proactive issue resolution across data pipelines and models.
  • Documentation: Document data models, pipelines, business definitions, and transformation logic to ensure transparency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing.
  • Business Logic Ownership: Define, implement, and standardize key business metrics (e.g. revenue, bookings, churn) to ensure consistency across reporting and analytics.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.
  • Performance & Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize SQL queries, dbt models, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and efficient use of data warehouse resources.

arbeitnow-sumup-senior-manager-tax-plann.description:
SumUp's tax function is scaling to match a business that now spans more than 40 entities. This role is a senior partner to the Head of Tax across the Group's tax agenda. You'll lead the implementation and operationalisation of corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax strategy, and you'll help shape the positions and policies behind it. You'll bring your own judgement to the most important topics, from how Pillar Two, CbCR, and ATAD III affect our structure to how we manage tax risk in audits, and you'll help the Head of Tax turn those views into a clear Group direction. This role reports to the Global Head of Tax and will have an impact on SumUp's IPO readiness.

What you'll do

  • Lead delivery of SumUp's tax agenda across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax, within the Group tax strategy set by the Head of Tax
  • Oversee the transfer pricing framework and its implementation, and propose improvements to both substance and automation
  • Draft and maintain tax policies, controls, and governance documentation for Group entities, for sign-off by the Head of Tax
  • Act as the first point of contact for tax authority audits and controversies, keeping the Head of Tax aligned on positions and exposure

arbeitnow-caronsale-machine-learning-eng.title: Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/x)
arbeitnow-caronsale-machine-learning-eng.description:
Four models in production today. Fifteen to twenty by mid-2027. The shared pipeline that gets them there has to hold — and you own everything after handoff: packaging, deployment, drift detection, and the call on whether a model is fit to serve.

Location: Central Berlin — you work from our office, hybrid with 3 days office and 2 days home office.

 

About us

CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform — and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer — as the operating system for an entire industry.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

 

The platform you build in

Our machine learning runs on one shared, central platform — not a separate pipeline per model. Five canonical stages: data extraction, validation, transformation, training and evaluation. A Snowflake data warehouse feeds a SageMaker managed feature store, and models reach production through governed CI/CD promotion lanes on Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Your job is to build inside it and make it stronger, so the next model costs less to ship than the last one.

 

Your responsibilities

  • You own models from handoff through to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring, and the decision on whether a model is ready to serve
  • You keep production models reliable — drift detection, performance monitoring, alerting and incident response when something moves
  • You own the serving and inference path: fitted pipeline artifacts, inference entry points, monitoring hooks and feature-store parity
  • You review model design and evaluation methodology before anything ships, and catch data leakage, backward-window errors and weak evaluation during development, while they are still cheap to fix
  • You extend the shared platform so it stays useful for every model, without project-specific logic leaking into shared code
  • You set the engineering standards the platform runs on as it scales across the organisation

 

What you bring

  • 4+ years in production machine learning engineering, with real ownership of models after handoff — not only training them
  • Strong Python: typed, tested, production-grade code, and you review the work of others
  • Enough machine learning depth to challenge a pipeline on problem framing, feature engineering, model selection and evaluation methodology
  • Hands-on experience with a managed ML platform — SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks or Azure ML — plus feature stores, CI/CD for machine learning, AWS and Terraform
  • An AI-native way of working: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot actively in your daily work
  • English at C1 level, written and spoken. German is not required — we work in English

Nice to have

  • Snowflake and dbt — you can pick both up here
  • Experience mentoring colleagues or reviewing their work
  • Comfort operating where the answer is not defined yet

What to expect from us

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in office, 2 days remote – plus 25 "Work from Anywhere" days per year
  • 28 days annual leave
  • 2× annual career & development conversations
  • Company pension with 20% employer contribution
  • Fully paid Deutschlandticket (public transport)
  • FitX membership or Urban Sports Club subsidy
  • Virtual stock options — share in the upside
  • Modern IT setup for your day-to-day work
  • Structured onboarding with buddy programme and social events
  • Lived diversity: active women's network, meditation & prayer room

 

Apply now — your CV is enough.

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

As an Inside Solutions Engineer, you will collaborate with sales representatives and partners to showcase the value of BeyondTrust’s products, services, and solutions. Acting as a technical specialist within the sales cycle, you will provide foundational support to highlight the capabilities of the BeyondTrust suite. This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop their technical expertise and customer-facing skills in a supportive, team-oriented environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist with marketing campaigns, including webinars and product demonstrations.
  • Support lead qualification by validating technical environments and understanding business problems.
  • Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, ensuring accurate and timely submissions.
  • Participate in discovery and opportunity engagement by conducting background research, qualifying questions, and understanding customer needs.
  • Articulate the business value of BeyondTrust solutions to prospects and customers.
  • Demonstrate how BeyondTrust solutions address customer challenges and deliver on the value proposition.
  • Assist in developing written proposals to complement financial proposals for prospects.
  • Play a key role in securing the technical win for opportunities by effectively presenting solutions and value.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience, including help desk and/or technical support of applications, server infrastructure, desktops, virtualization, and directories.
  • Good understanding of common operating systems and network topologies.
  • Familiarity with foundational security concepts and practices.
  • Ability to assess technical requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to thrive in a team-selling environment.
  • Comfortable delivering presentations to audiences of varying sizes.
  • Security+, Network+, or equivalent industry certifications.

Nice To Have

  • Pre-sales experience is advantageous but not required.
  • Basic working knowledge of Linux and Azure Active Directory.
  • Familiarity with BeyondTrust products (Privilege Management for Desktops, Remote Support, Privileged Remote Access).
  • Security-focused qualifications or certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with security solutions such as anti-malware, data protection, firewalls, and mobile/email/web security.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

arbeitnow-sonyinteractiveentertainmentgl.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, develop and operate trusted, scalable data solutions that power decision-making and transformation across Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE). Working within Player Data Engineering, you will build reusable data pipelines, integration services and curated data products for business domains including Commerce, hardware, game play, products and services, and accounts.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. You will partner with engineering, platform, product and business teams. Take end-to-end ownership of complex solutions and raise engineering standards through technical leadership and mentoring. You will help create reliable, governed and AI-ready Player data foundations.

What you'll be doing:

Design, deliver and maintain Player data solutions

  • Design, build, test and maintain robust batch and near-real-time data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows across Player data systems, APIs, Snowflake Db and cloud data environments.
  • Develop reusable, well-documented data models and domain-aligned data products, translating complex business logic into reliable engineering solutions.
  • Lead technical design for assigned initiatives, evaluate trade-offs, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable and cost-effective.

Own quality, reliability and operations

  • Own solutions throughout the engineering lifecycle, from requirements and design through deployment, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous improvement.
  • Implement automated testing, data validation, reconciliation, lineage, observability, alerting and operational runbooks.
  • Apply engineering practices including version control, code review, CI/CD, infrastructure automation and appropriate change controls; improve performance and platform efficiency.

Provide technical leadership and collaborate

  • Mentor engineers, lead technical reviews and contribute to shared patterns, coding standards and communities of practice.
  • Partner with TPM’s, business stakeholders, architects, security, governance, analytics and platform teams to clarify requirements, dependencies and data ownership.
  • Proactively identify delivery risks, technical debt and cross-team dependencies; communicate progress, options and recommendations clearly.
  • Enable trusted data for analytics, planning, automation and AI use cases while respecting privacy, security and access controls.

What we're looking for:

  • Typically 5+ years of professional data engineering or software engineering experience, including ownership of complex production data solutions.
  • Experience designing data pipelines and transformations using modern ETL/ELT tools and frameworks, such as dbt, Ab Initio or equivalent technologies.
  • Solid experience with cloud data platforms and warehouses, particularly Snowflake; knowledge of data modelling, dimensional design and data product principles.
  • Experience with orchestration, Kubernetes, Git-based workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and troubleshooting production data services.
  • Understanding of data security, access management, data quality, governance and regulatory considerations in enterprise environments.
  • Experience leveraging AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-driven development tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve code quality.
  • Familiarity with building or integrating AI agents into data engineering workflows would be a strong plus.
  • Ability to influence technical decisions, mentor peers and communicate effectively with engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

Desirable Experience

  • Strong hands-on SQL and Python skills, with experience in distributed data processing using PySpark and/or Databricks.
  • Experience with AWS services, APIs, event-driven integration and infrastructure as code.

arbeitnow-scopely-director-of-product-fe.description:
Scopely is looking for a Director of Product, Features to lead the features teams for Star Trek Fleet Command, based in London on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top 10 gross revenue Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You’ll Do

This individual will own the long-view strategic planning across the game’s Features ensuring alignment between strategic vision and tactical execution. Key responsibilities include:

  • Own the business performance of the Features function, accountable for delivering game KPIs and guiding decisions which drive sustainable long term growth.
  • Own every aspect of a roadmap that achieves KPI goals set by you and the Product Team. Guiding cross-functional partners such as game designers, UX designers and artists to deliver a product that meets the product’s vision and strategy
  • Formulate product strategy and create engaging game mechanics and core game loops
  • See feature development through from concept to launch, including post launch analysis and optimization, to deliver best in class features that achieve set KPI goals 
  • Lead engagement and monetisation for major feature releases, coordinating across disciplines to ensure smooth, high-impact launches which hit KPI targets.
  • Monitor the health of the product ecosystem, using insights to proactively identify opportunities and risks, and implement impactful features and initiatives
  • Identify and create process improvements to support feature development 
  • Build a high-performing team, mentoring product managers and operational staff, scaling team capabilities, and fostering a culture of ownership and excellence.
  • Establish institutional knowledge through clear documentation of experiments, retrospectives, and playbooks to ensure consistent learning and improvement.
  • Conduct quantitative analyses of data to provide key insights into product performance and uncover opportunities for further engagement and monetization
  • Leverage player feedback and game data to inform roadmap and feature design solutions. Use competitive market research to identify future opportunities and feature best practices
  • Manage and develop a team of talented Product Managers 

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous work experience with free-to-play games
  • Strong leadership skills.
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical ability with attention to detail.
  • Understanding of game design concepts and principles.
  • Experience hitting revenue/metric targets on a live game.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for figuring out how game economies work.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • An MBA or a Degree in Economics, Business, Statistics, Data Analytics, or Finance is a plus.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

arbeitnow-flock-engineering-lead.title: Engineering Lead
arbeitnow-flock-engineering-lead.description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. THE ROLE Engineering Lead for the Acquisition team. You’ll work closely with the PM to lead the team toward its goals, owning delivery, operational reliability and developer experience. You’ll ship production code and provide technical coaching and leadership to the engineers around you, not line management. You’ll also shape how the team uses AI tools and coding agents to ship faster without lowering the quality bar. WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: Lead a team building products that directly drive Flock’s growth Own delivery and technical quality for the Acquisition team, working hand in hand with the PM to ship features that directly impact how fleets find and choose Flock. Write high-quality, well-tested TypeScript and own end-to-end delivery to production Partner with product to drive impact Work closely with the PM, the Engineering Leadership Team and stakeholders to translate business goals into clear technical scope, success metrics and delivery plans. Grow engineers around you Lead by example through code, design discussions and pairing. Coach and mentor engineers across the team to raise standards and share ownership of technical direction. Shape how the team works, not just what it builds Drive improvements to developer experience, CI/CD, observability and release practices that make the whole team faster and more confident. Make pragmatic trade-offs that balance reliability, performance and cost across AWS services. Decide how the team uses AI, from coding assistants to agent workflows in review and release, keeping engineering judgement where it matters. Curious how we build the future of fleet insurance? Dive into our Product & Engineering Blog, packed with technical deep-dives, behind-the-scenes stories, and real insights from the team you’d be joining. A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING: As an Engineering Lead at Flock you’ll own delivery and technical direction for the Acquisition team, co-leading with the PM to ship products that directly drive growth, while raising the bar for the engineers around you. API-Driven Development Integrate with and contribute to the development of RESTful APIs exposed via API Gateway. Serverless & Cloud Infrastructure Use your AWS experience (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch) to support and extend the Acquisition team’s services and pipelines. Work with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CDK for provisioning and managing cloud resources. Collaboration & Agile Delivery Co-own the team’s success with the PM, jointly leading projects from scoping and planning through to delivery and measuring impact. Give engineers the space and ownership to lead projects themselves, asking the right questions to challenge their thinking and help them land on the right solution. Code Quality & Technical Standards Deliver high-quality, well-tested code and act as a force-multiplier, raising standards through code reviews, pairing and design discussions. Champion practical testing, type-safe APIs and pragmatic patterns that shape long-term technical direction across the team. Set the example on AI-assisted development and coach engineers on where it genuinely speeds the team up and where human judgement needs to stay in the loop. Working closely with your PM, you’ll bring clarity to complex problems and help define sharply scoped, impactful deliverables. Your success won’t be measured by your own output alone, but by the output, quality and growth of the whole team around you. WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK: ESSENTIAL Proven ability to co-lead a team alongside a PM, taking joint ownership of delivery, quality and outcomes, not just your own output. Strong hands-on engineering ability; comfortable shipping high-quality, well-tested TypeScript in production and holding the team to the same standard. Significant experience with AWS and modern serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch) or other cloud platforms. A pragmatic approach to technical decisions, balancing reliability, observability, performance and cost, and bringing engineers along on the reasoning. Track record of raising engineering standards as a force-multiplier, through code reviews, pairing, design discussions and shaping long-term technical direction. Strong communication skills; able to represent the team upwards and translate business goals into clear technical scope and delivery plans. Experience improving developer experience, CI/CD, release practices and delivery cadence across a team. Confident using AI development tools every day, with experience of helping a team adopt them without letting quality slip. PREFERABLE Experience aligning technical direction beyond your immediate team, working with senior stakeholders and other leads to shape how engineering works at a broader level. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CDK, with a track record of improving operational resilience through observability, runbooks and automated recovery. Practical experience designing event-driven, distributed systems and navigating the trade-offs that come with eventual consistency at scale. Background in a fast-moving, product-led environment where commercial impact drives decisions and adapting quickly is part of the job. A track record of creating the conditions for engineers to step up, not just mentoring but actively giving ownership and space to grow. WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary) 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 Share Incentive Plan 📈 Workplace Pension 💰 Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options) Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵 Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣 £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓 £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻 We work

arbeitnow-openai-senior-counsel-eu-polic.description: About the Team OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises professionals from diverse fields, including technology, AI, privacy, IP, commercial, corporate, employment, tax law, regulatory, and litigation. About the Role We’re seeking an experienced lawyer to join OpenAI’s EU Policy/Regulatory Legal team. You will own assigned legal matters and workstreams concerning EU and UK AI and digital regulation, prepare practical legal advice, and support engagements with the EU AI Office, other regulators and policymakers. Working with our Associate General Counsel, EU Policy/Regulatory, you will assess regulatory developments, develop legal recommendations and help translate them into action across OpenAI’s products and operations. We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer who can work independently, exercise sound judgment in unfamiliar areas, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across teams. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your work while identifying material risks and knowing when to escalate. This individual-contributor role reports to our Associate General Counsel, EU Policy/Regulatory. In this role, you will: Prepare for and participate in OpenAI’s EU and UK engagements with the European Commission, EU member states, other EU institutions, national regulators and policymakers, including briefing materials and follow-up actions. Advise on the interpretation and application of existing and emerging AI, digital and technology regulation, and translate complex regulatory requirements into practical legal and business guidance. Assess regulatory developments, enforcement risks and policy proposals, and develop legal recommendations for the AGC on their implications for OpenAI’s products and operations. Work with US and EU legal colleagues to deliver coordinated advice and progress assigned cross-border matters. Partner with Global Affairs, policy and regulatory affairs colleagues to draft legal input into policy positions, consultation responses, regulatory guidance, codes of practice and industry standards. Own assigned workstreams for regulatory inquiries, investigations and supervisory engagements, including drafting responses, coordinating factual inputs and escalating material issues to the AGC. You might thrive in this role if you: 10+ years of legal experience. Law degree (JD, LL.B., or equivalent) and qualification to practice law in at least one relevant jurisdiction. Experience advising on EU or UK technology regulatory matters and independently managing legal workstreams. Relevant in-house, law firm and/or government or institutional legal experience. Experience analyzing complex legislation and regulations, including technology laws such as the EU AI Act, Data Act, Digital Services Act, Online Safety Act, GDPR or Digital Markets Act, and the ability to develop expertise in new frameworks. Familiarity with EU legislative and regulatory processes and the respective roles of EU institutions and national authorities. Experience preparing for or participating in engagements with European regulators or policymakers, including drafting clear, accurate submissions and briefing materials. Ability to produce clear and concise writing, distilling complex concepts into simple, explainable, and persuasive ideas. Ability to work independently on assigned matters, exercise sound judgment and recognize when to escalate material risks or seek specialist input. Ability to move between legal analysis, regulatory strategy and practical implementation, and to identify the issues that matter most to the business. Ability to manage competing deadlines, coordinate contributions from other teams and take matters through to delivery. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to give practical advice and influence colleagues without relying on managerial authority. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Brand Marketing Lead to join our Brand & Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help own our brand marketing strategy and campaign execution across six European markets and be part of our marketing team as we scale our spend management platform. If you're excited about building category-defining campaigns that move Pleo from a good solution to the undisputed choice for mid-market finance leaders and are passionate about brand strategy and creative execution, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to the Director of Integrated Marketing, and work in close collaboration with the Director of Brand Experience and Strategy, as well as the Brand Intelligence Manager, our brand foundations team, PR, content marketing and digital channels team. You’ll partner cross-functionally with PMM, MOPS, CX and sales. This is a hands-on, IC role, where you'll do both the thinking and the work—strategy and execution both sit with you. What you’ll be doing As a Brand Marketing Lead, you will: Own the brand marketing strategy that moves Pleo from ‘one of many’ to the undisputed choice for mid-market European finance leaders. Build and execute integrated brand campaigns from concept through to reporting — learning from what we’ve just launched, and pushing further. Create branded content that shows how financial services should be done. Content that recognizes the precision, rigor, and craft that finance leaders bring to their work. Manage the funnel strategically — balancing awareness, consideration, and conversion. Not just fishing in the pond of people who already know us, but earning the right to speak to people we don’t know yet. Own your budget and agency relationships — you’re the strategic partner they answer to. Measure what matters — working with Brand Intelligence, Integrated Marketing, Data, and MOps to track brand lift, earned media, consideration, and how brand work flows into pipeline and revenue. Set the benchmark for brand work in fintech — prove that category-defining campaigns come from strategic rigor and creative excellence working together. You’ll establish Pleo as the model for how brands should think about their audience, and show that understanding someone better than anyone else is a more powerful differentiator than any feature. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years in brand marketing (B2B or fintech might be helpful, but we care more about the thinking than the category) A portfolio of work that shows you’ve led campaigns from strategy through to execution — ideally integrated campaigns that work across multiple channels Strong stakeholder management skills — you can influence a room, sell an idea, and push back when something isn’t working Strategic thinking + execution mindset — you’re equally comfortable building a 6-month brand strategy and getting your hands dirty on day-to-day campaign work Comfort with ambiguity and pace — this is a growing company, and things move fast. You thrive in that Understanding of how brand and pipeline connect — you know that brand campaigns need to serve business growth, not just awareness A point of view on category dynamics — you can look at a market and spot where everyone’s getting it wrong A strong understanding for when/how to localise concepts, messaging & GTM campaigns across different markets. Fluency in one or more of our European markets is a bonus (not required, but helpful) Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want to reframe an entire category's conversation by competing on human insight rather than just feature parity. You thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment where you can build campaigns that serve as a 5-year foundation. You believe brand strategy must be grounded in audience understanding and directly drive business outcomes. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer purely high-level strategy without getting hands-on with day-to-day campaign execution. You operate best in rigid, highly structured environments with slow moving pace and minimal ambiguity. You view brand marketing in isolation from performance data, pipeline metrics, and commercial growth. arbeitnow-plos-associate-editorial-direc.title: Associate Editorial Director- 2 Year FTC
arbeitnow-plos-associate-editorial-direc.description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 2 Year FTC.

Role Summary

In this role you will oversee a subset of the growing PLOS journals portfolio: you will manage PLOS Biology and PLOS Medicine, with line-management of their professional Editors-in-Chief, and provide editorial oversight for a diverse set of journals led by academic volunteers across a range of disciplines in biology, human and environmental health. You will manage in line with PLOS strategy, helping to keep PLOS at the forefront of open science publishing and trusted content. You will leverage your strong relationships with the scientific community to drive engagement and develop the journals to meet the evolving needs of their global communities. You will work collaboratively with the journals’ Editorial Boards, and in-house colleagues, to create and deliver against journal strategies, using your international networks to grow PLOS’ profile and reputation.

The role is an integral part of the senior PLOS editorial leadership. As such, you will be expected to engage PLOS Leaders’ Framework—adaptive decision-making, empowering others, iterative learning, agility, resilience, systems thinking, continuous improvement, catalysing opportunity—at an advanced level. As part of that leadership, you will also own ad hoc projects across the entire PLOS journals portfolio. Priority projects currently relate to quality control, workflow optimization, cost efficiency, non-article research outputs (data and code), policy development and community engagement. You will embrace change, and lead your teams effectively through it.

 

Responsibilities

Journal portfolio management

  • Work closely with the Directors of Editorial, Publishing, MarComms and Global Development to develop an editorial strategy for a portfolio of PLOS journals that supports PLOS’s commitments to Open Science, DEI, community engagement, trusted content and customer service
  • Identify and develop opportunities to expand the portfolio in line with PLOS strategy
  • Develop and oversee attainment of multi-term performance metrics for individual journals
  • Partner with the Publishing Director to develop and manage annual budgets, ensuring responsible decision-making and efficient resource allocation to meet both budget and quality standards
  • Work closely with Operations colleagues and vendors to oversee optimization of editorial workflows, systems and reporting
  • Work closely with Marketing and Communications colleagues to ensure promotion of journal content and PLOS’ mission, and to drive journal submissions and uptake of Open Science practices
  • Ensure that Editorial makes effective and efficient use of cross-journal Centers of Excellence (e.g. Publication Ethics, Editorial Board Services)
  • Ensure that the portfolio shares cohesive and consistent editorial policies and quality standards, reacting dynamically to changing community needs while forefronting Open Science
  • Lead cross-journal initiatives, overseeing development of systems and workflows
  • Oversee Editorial participation in community initiatives, conferences and events, ensuring equality of opportunity and alignment with PLOS’ mission
  • Help to ensure best-practice document hygiene and information sharing by everyone in Editorial

People management

  • Lead a high-performing and cohesive team of Editorial staff (up to 4 direct reports), fostering a cross-portfolio and cross-cultural mindset
  • Ensure strategy is collaboratively translated into clear tactics for teams and individual staff, and monitor progress against goals regularly
  • Lead by example, modeling open and clear communication and ensuring all stakeholders understand their roles and responsibilities
  • Build strong relationships with Editorial Boards within a true partnership framework
  • Address underperformance swiftly, sensitively and supportively, in collaboration with Line Manager and People & Culture team
  • Act as a thought-partner to, and deputize for, the Editorial Director

Diversity, equity and inclusion

  • Oversee improvement of the diversity of PLOS staff, Editorial Boards, peer-reviewers and authors
  • Work collaboratively with stakeholders to eliminate bias in manuscript processing and editorial decision-making
  • Oversee editorial participation in internal and external DEI initiatives

Cross-sector 

  • Maintain in-depth industry knowledge, awareness of market trends, innovations and evolving customer needs
  • Represent PLOS at industry events occasionally (approx 1-2 events per year)

 

Qualifications and Experience

  • PhD and post-doctoral experience (or equivalent) in a relevant subject area
  • Substantial editorial experience (5+ years) with progressively increased managerial responsibility in STM publishing required
  • Track record in managing a group of successful journals and teams distributed internationally
  • Passionate interest in science and scientists
  • Proven commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion in science and scholarly publication.
  • Strong business acumen
  • Wide network of contacts within global scientific communities
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically, to innovate and to implement creative solutions
  • Experienced people manager with a track record of managing high-performing teams through change
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

 

The base salary range we've established for these positions is £90,000- £104,000. PLOS also offers a comprehenseive benefits package sumarized below.

UK: 

  • Private medical insurance 
  • Life assurance 
  • Income protection  
  • Personal accident insurance 
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match 
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave

arbeitnow-monzoreferrals-senior-data-sci.title: Senior Data Scientist
arbeitnow-monzoreferrals-senior-data-sci.description:
📍London | UK remote | 💰 £80,000 to £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Hear from the team

About our Data Science Team:

We're looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist excited to help build the bank of the future. You'll have the opportunity to super charge our user engagement in 2025 and help us to build a bank that customers truly love.

At Monzo, we're building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 11 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.

Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives data scientists the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.

How we hire

We are excited to be expanding and are hiring for multiple roles across our Data Science teams! Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth, or Core, we are looking for talented individuals with a versatile skill set to contribute across our squads. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!

What you’ll be working on 

We work in cross-functional squads where every data scientist is a member of a central data discipline and fully embedded into 1 product squad alongside engineers, designers, marketers, product managers etc.

Your day-to-day   

  • Applying your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand how our users interact with our products and how those insights can inform our product strategy
  • Guide and enable product teams to measure things that matter; initiate or help run A/B experiments to keep improving everything we do
  • Drive together with the finance team a unified company-wide understanding of the lifetime value of our users and how different product features are impacting user profitability
  • Liaise with engineers to keep making sure we collect the right data to produce relevant business insights

You should apply if:

What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

  • You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, product, users and very importantly your colleagues as well
  • You're commercially minded and can put numbers into business perspective
  • You’re as comfortable getting hands-on as taking a step back and thinking strategically
  • You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so
  • You're a team player whom your colleagues can rely on
  • You have solid grounding in SQL and preferably Python
  • You have experience in conducting large scale A/B experiments

The Interview Process:

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

  1. Recruiter Call
  2. Initial Call 
  3. Technical Interview
  4. Final Interview including a case study and collaboration interview 

Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.

What’s in it for you:

💰 £80,000 to £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅ We can sponsor visas 

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

arbeitnow-vmlenterprisesolutions-senior-.title: Senior Content Designer UK
arbeitnow-vmlenterprisesolutions-senior-.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

 

Senior Content Designer needed to join our Design Team on a permanent basis.

 

The opportunity

We’re looking for a confident, creative and versatile Senior Content Designer to work on our client’s website experience.

As a Senior Content Designer, you’ll be shaping experiences that are rewarding, personalised and effortless in every interaction.

You’ll find new opportunities and improve existing journeys, crafting intuitive and engaging solutions for major product initiatives, multi-step journeys, campaign activity and vehicle launches.

You’ll weigh business objectives with user expectations, delivering content that exceeds both. And you’ll use language to engage, inform, guide and persuade.

So, you’ll really need to know the value the right content can add to a customer journey. Plus, you’ll need a big appetite for using customer research, data and analytics and smart uses of AI to guide your design process.

You’ll work mostly independently, with support from a Content Lead to provide direction, review your work and help navigate complex decisions.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own Major Initiatives & Launches: Drive the end-to-end content design for flagship launches, multi-step customer flows, and complex campaign-driven journeys across digital platforms.
  • Be the Content Advocate in Early Discovery: Partner early with product managers and UX leads in the concept phase, shaping product intent, defining information hierarchy, and solving UX problems with content before visuals are developed.
  • Architect Complex Journeys: Design and structure multi-step content architecture, taxonomy, and navigation paths to ensure seamless transitions across complex digital touchpoints.
  • Evolve the Content Design System: Define and document reusable content components, patterns, and copy standards within our design system to ensure long-term consistency across digital products.
  • Establish Governance Frameworks: Define clear content governance models, review processes, and quality frameworks so high standards and brand consistency are maintained post-launch.
  • Drive Data-Informed Decisions: Interrogate quantitative performance data (conversion, drop-off, engagement) and qualitative research to formulate hypotheses, test copy variations, and make evidence-based design iterations.
  • Foster Cross-Functional Alignment: Work autonomously with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and Legal to align journey messaging with product requirements.
  • Ensure Accessibility & Inclusivity: Ensure all multi-step flows and launch content comply with modern accessibility standards (WCAG), plain language requirements, and assistive technology needs.
  • Leverage Modern Tooling: Work hands-on in tools like Figma and FigJam to document user flows, wireframe content layouts, prototype copy in situ, and explore AI-assisted workflows to optimise efficiency.

 

What we want from you

  • Deep Content Design Experience: Proven track record designing content for complex digital products, multi-step journeys, or major customer-facing campaign launches.
  • Complex Journey & Architecture Skills: Demonstrated capability in content architecture, information hierarchy, and structuring complicated user flows into clear, intuitive journeys.
  • Early-Phase UX Advocacy: Experience collaborating with product and design partners at the problem-framing stage, shaping the solution before high-fidelity design work starts.
  • Design Systems & Governance Experience: Practical experience developing, documenting, or applying content design system components, style guidelines, and governance processes.
  • Strong Data Literacy: Comfortable using analytics, conversion metrics, and user research findings to steer content decisions and evaluate performance.
  • Cross-Discipline Alignment: Skilled at collaborating autonomously with stakeholders across product, marketing, and brand to align on goals and resolve conflicting priorities.
  • Figma & Prototyping: Hands-on experience working directly inside Figma and modern collaborative tools to prototype content alongside UX/UI designers.
  • Accessibility Expertise: A thorough working knowledge of digital accessibility, screen-reader compatibility, and inclusive language principles.
  • Relevant Background: A degree or equivalent hands-on experience in English, Communications, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), UX Design, or a related field. Proof of user-centred decisions, testing or iteration.

 

If you know some of this, even better

arbeitnow-granola-gtm-systems-lead.description: About Us We're Team Granola 👋 Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters. We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on. About the Role We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale. You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them. This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works. What You’ll Do Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow. Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role. Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com , Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business. Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious. Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack. Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security. Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones. What We’re Looking For Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM. Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues. Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful. An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably. A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time. Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite. A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use. You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here. About the Opportunity We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity. Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out. arbeitnow-checkatrade-senior-software-en.description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. You'll work alongside the vetting and reviews teams, who are on the front line of trust, and build the infrastructure that lets them work with confidence. When something breaks in production, you'll lead the response. When something looks brittle at design time, you'll say so. The job, unfiltered: Own and evolve the systems behind how tradespeople are verified, how reviews flow through our platform and how content is moderated. Lead the response when things break: read distributed traces, correlate logs across services and find the cause, not just the symptom. Design event-driven workflows that are reliable by default: idempotent, retryable, with dead-letter handling that doesn't need a 2am wake-up to unpick. Work directly with the vetting and reviews teams to understand what trust means day to day, then build systems that hold up to it. Tighten the operational seams: better monitoring, clearer alerting, locked-down auth and outbox patterns that keep data consistent. The fit: Strong TypeScript. You're comfortable owning a service end to end, from schema to deployment. Fastify or a similar Node.js framework, and enough HTTP know-how that it rarely surprises you. Event-driven instincts: you know what idempotency means in practice and why the outbox pattern exists. Full-stack comfort, Next.js included. You ship the frontend as happily as the service behind it. Datadog fluency (APM traces, log search, metric queries), SQL for diagnostics during an incident, and GCP basics such as Pub/Sub backlogs and DLQs. Experience leading production incidents, not just being in them. You communicate clearly under pressure and drive to a fix. An eye for systemic problems at review time, not at post-mortem time, and a habit of making the people around you better. Regular use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, and a keen interest in helping the team get more out of them. arbeitnow-nearform-forward-deployed-engi.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
arbeitnow-nearform-forward-deployed-engi.description:
This is a full-time, permanent opportunity for candidates based in the UK.

This position also requires frequent travel to client sites within Europe, with travel expenses covered by the company.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.  

About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will help build, implement, and deploy agentic platforms within client environments. Your role will focus on building and deploying scalable AI-driven solutions, enabling organisations to operationalise LLM-powered agents across products, processes, and teams. You will work closely with client stakeholders, technical leaders, and delivery teams to build, and roll out agentic capabilities that integrate seamlessly with existing enterprise systems and frameworks. 

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level. Our Seniors typically have at least 8 years of commercial experience.
  • Experience designing and building agentic platforms using Python and modern AI frameworks.
  • Architect LLM orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and related technologies.
  • Implement multi-agent systems supporting tool use, workflow orchestration, memory, and decision-making.
  • Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines integrating enterprise data sources.
  • Integrate agentic platforms with client systems, including APIs, data platforms, cloud services, and enterprise applications.
  • The ability to configure Kubernetes and deploy workloads.
  • Design deployment architectures across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments.
  • Ability to collaborate efficiently in teams of technical and non-technical individuals.
  • Comfort working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and direct iteration with users.
  • Strong consulting experience to plan, execute, and deliver complex client engagements, solving real business problems.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance. 
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem! 
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - We understand the importance of continuously learning so we offer an allowance of up to €1000 (equivalent in GBP) you can use to upskill yourself.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

 

Our Interview Process

  • Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
    An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.
  • Technical Assessment (1 hour via Zoom)
    A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your Python expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
    A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project

 

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.


Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence. 

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.  

Our salary range starts from £75,000 + bonus & benefits and will be discussed during the initial interview based on your experience.
