Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation for Benelux  & Nordics (m/f/d)

Position Summary

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to VP of Global GTM .We are seeking an elite, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across top-tier accounts. Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world’s most mission-critical ERP environments.

 

Key Responsibilities

Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. 

The SAP "Triple Threat": 

  1. Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles.
  2. SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects  to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations.
  3. GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations.

C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity).

Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base.

Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP’s rigorous reporting standards.

 

Required Skills/Experience

  • Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner).
  • Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
  • Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees.
  • Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP’s regional field teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO.
  • Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth
  • Language: Professional fluency in English. Additional regional language skills are a strong plus (written and spoken).

Our offer:

  • You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, and an attractive salary.
  • You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.
  • Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.
  • The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.
  • Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.

 

About Onapsis

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world’s leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

About the role 

Reporting to the SVP, Global Engineering and Infrastructure, the Senior Director of Health & Safety Operations Europe serves as a strategic leader driving safety excellence across our European operations. You will champion the development and implementation of robust H&S strategies, ensuring full regulatory compliance while fostering a world-class safety culture. This role demands a visionary leader capable of influencing cross-functional teams and implementing industry-best practices to minimize risk and achieve ambitious safety performance goals.

What you’ll do

  • Define and execute the European H&S strategy, aligning safety milestones with broader business objectives.
  • Cultivate a "Zero Incident" organizational culture by architecting risk-reduction programs across all operations.
  • Safeguard the business by ensuring rigorous compliance with local and international safety regulations and certifications.
  • Standardize safety processes across diverse sites using our newly developed, proprietary safety framework.
  • Partner with Supply Chain and Site Operations leadership to integrate safety into the heart of production practices.
  • Leverage data to track KPIs, providing senior leadership with actionable insights and performance reports.
  • Lead high-stakes incident investigations, ensuring deep root-cause analysis and the execution of effective corrective actions.
  • Act as the primary representative for safety matters with regulatory bodies and external stakeholders across Europe.
  • Orchestrate internal and external safety audits to ensure consistent best-practice standards across all regions.
  • Mentor and develop a high-performing team of safety experts, fostering professional growth and succession planning.
  • Pioneer the use of AI and emerging technologies as accelerators for continuous improvement and safety innovation.

What you’ll bring

  • 15+ years of safety management experience, with at least 5 years in a high-impact leadership role.
  • Subject matter expertise in European safety regulations, multi-national frameworks, and compliance standards.
  • Industry background in FMCG, Logistics, Manufacturing, or Fulfillment preferred.
  • Proven track record of implementing scalable safety strategies across complex, international geographies.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate safety data into strategic business decisions.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders at all levels.
  • A relentless passion for safety and a dedication to continuous operational improvement.
  • Strong leadership presence with a focus on empowering teams and maximizing individual potential.

What we offer 

  • Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
  • Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
  • Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
  • Benefit from long-term wealth creation: Your compensation is heavily weighted toward equity, directly aligning your personal success with the company's future through our Virtual Stock Option (VSO) and Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) plans.
  • Thrive in a high-performance environment: Work with ambitious, intellectually curious peers on a global scale, enjoying an environment built for empowerment and speed.

arbeitnow-lemonway-sales-enablement-stag.description: Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne. Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds. Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés. Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund. Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable. Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement) Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix) Le rôle Au sein de notre équipe Alternative Finance Sales , vous contribuerez à renforcer l’efficacité des activités commerciales, de la préparation des campagnes de prospection à la structuration des données et des outils Sales. Ce stage vous permettra de jouer un rôle actif dans le développement commercial de Lemonway, en participant à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités, au mapping de comptes stratégiques et à la préparation de campagnes de prospection ciblées. Vous découvrirez progressivement l’ensemble du cycle de vente, avec l’opportunité de participer aux rendez-vous commerciaux et de contribuer concrètement aux différentes étapes du développement de nos activités. Vos missions Rechercher et cartographier des comptes stratégiques, leurs activités et leurs décideurs. Identifier les interlocuteurs pertinents et enrichir les bases de prospects. Participer à la préparation de campagnes de prospection ciblées. Contribuer à la rédaction de messages et de séquences d’e-mails. Mettre à jour et fiabiliser les données dans Salesforce. Réaliser des recherches de marché et une veille concurrentielle sur les paiements et la FinTech. Identifier des opportunités d’automatisation et contribuer à la création d’outils utilisant l’intelligence artificielle. Préparer des supports commerciaux et participer ponctuellement à des rendez-vous. Ce que vous apprendrez Les fondamentaux du Business Development et de la prospection B2B. Les méthodes de recherche, de mapping et d’analyse de comptes. La construction de campagnes commerciales ciblées. L’utilisation d’un CRM et d’outils de prospection. Les enjeux du marché des paiements et de la finance alternative. Les applications concrètes de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle dans les activités commerciales. Vous êtes en dernière année d’école de commerce, d’université ou d’une formation en commerce, marketing, finance, stratégie, data ou technologie, et vous recherchez un stage de fin d’études. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne : Curieuse, volontaire et désireuse d’apprendre. Intéressée par la vente B2B, la FinTech, les paiements et les nouvelles technologies. À l’aise avec la recherche d’informations, l’analyse et la structuration de données. Rigoureuse, organisée et attentive à la qualité des informations collectées. Autonome, impliquée et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Dotée d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une réelle envie de contribuer. La maîtrise de l’ espagnol constitue un atout important. arbeitnow-amo-software-engineer-web-full.title: Software Engineer, Web (Full stack)
arbeitnow-amo-software-engineer-web-full.description: We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel. In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data. We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts with a high sense of ownership. This commitment to expertise is an expectation for every team member. As a Web Engineer, your day-to-day will include: Platform Engineering Designing and building robust, scalable web platforms end-to-end in TypeScript: APIs, services, data access layers and the UI on top of them. You’ll make the architectural decisions and set the patterns that others build on. Workflows & Data Pipelines Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale. Data Modeling & Visualization Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. You’ll handle data with privacy in mind from the very first design decision. Maps & Geospatial Data Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful. Roadmap Creation and Ideation Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective. Owning your scope You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks. Your Skills & Experience: Please indicate your years of experience on the application form. 7+ years of professional experience building SaaS products or data-heavy platforms. High proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in modern web frameworks (React, Next.js…). Strong experience with Postgres and data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar). Solid understanding of data modeling for analytics and for visualizing large volumes of data. A privacy-aware approach to handling sensitive data, such as aggregation and anonymization. Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend. Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running processes (Restate, Temporal, or similar) is a big plus. Expertise in map rendering and geospatial data visualization (Mapbox GL, MapLibre, deck.gl , or similar) is a big plus. Experience with WebGL or GPU rendering is a plus. Comfortable working closely with backend and data teams across a polyglot stack is a plus. Knowledge of infrastructure (Bazel, GCP, Kubernetes) is a plus. Passion and experience building great products. We’d love to hear about things you’ve shipped! AI as a multiplier AI is part of how we build every day. We’re looking for engineers with a real grasp of these tools, who use them to multiply their output and not to make up for missing expertise. You should be able to drive an agent through a complex change, judge what it produces, spot where it’s subtly wrong, and stand behind every line that ships. The bar We’re looking for exceptional engineers, and we set the bar high on purpose. In return, you’ll get real ownership from day one, products used by millions of people, a team that ships in days rather than quarters, a modern stack with top-tier tooling, and colleagues who will push you to grow. You don’t need to speak French to apply (and you don’t need perfect English; we’ll help you ramp up quickly). Life at amo: To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you: We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A). We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light! Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover: Health care (100% coverage). Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%). Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎). 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state); 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract); ~11 bank holidays. We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. Relocation We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with: Help and sponsored visa process. 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival. Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home. Help with french paperwork like opening a french social security account, tax forms, getting your carte vitale (free healthcare) and more. French lessons to be fully set with your new Parisian life. arbeitnow-prelude-mid-market-account-exe.description: About Prelude Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever. Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss. Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead. Why join us Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed. We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build. Our values Care We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship. Bias for Action We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory. Ownership We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results. About the Role As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you'll be responsible for driving growth across one of Prelude’s most strategic segments: mid-sized businesses with high-scale authentication needs. You’ll own the full sales cycle, manage complex evaluations with multiple stakeholders, and partner closely with our technical teams to deliver high-impact solutions. You’ll help shape our mid-market motion, refine our GTM strategy, and play a meaningful role in expanding Prelude’s footprint across Europe and beyond. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has experience closing mid-market deals and wants to join a fast-growing startup where their impact is immediate and visible. What will you be doing? • Owning and managing the sales cycle for mid-market accounts, from outbound prospecting to contract execution. • Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of high-value prospects across key verticals. • Leading consultative discovery processes to understand customer needs, technical requirements, and decision criteria. • Delivering high-quality demos and value-driven pitches tailored to mid-market use cases. • Navigating multiple stakeholders — from product and engineering to procurement and legal. • Consistently exceeding quota while maintaining healthy win rates and sales velocity. • Delivering on cross-sell, up-sell and renewal opportunities • Sharing insights from customer interactions to help refine product strategy, messaging, and positioning. • Representing Prelude at industry events, conferences, and on-site customer meetings. What are we looking for? • Experience in B2B SaaS sales, including experience closing mid-market deals. • A strong track record of achieving or exceeding quota. • Confidence managing multi-stakeholder, multi-step sales processes • Curiosity - you'll enjoy unpacking how products work under the hood. • The ability to think strategically about accounts, to identify and engage economic buyers. • Someone who will thrive in a fast-paced environment, who enjoys taking initiative. • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. • Fluency in English and French • Enthusiasm for our product and potential What we offer: • Competitive salary with uncapped commission and generous BSPCEs. • Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office, 1 day remote • High-quality equipment and ergonomic setup. • Annual company offsite (most recent was in the South of France). • A close-knit, high-caliber team that prioritizes product excellence and customer success. • Private healthcare. • Pension scheme. • Swile meal vouchers. Interview Process • A 30-minute call with our talent team to get to know each other. • A 30-minute session with someone in the sales team to go deeper into the role. • On-site interview at our Paris office, including a sales presentation and team meet-and-greet. • A 1-hour meeting with our CEO to explore our strategy and long-term vision. arbeitnow-voodoo-senior-backend-engineer.description: About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way. This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available. Team For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become. You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding. You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you. This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game. You will be central to that transition. Role You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that. Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will: Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server. Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted. Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities. The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang). To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions. Profile 5+ years of backend development experience Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment) Mastery of SQL and NoSQL Background in high-scale systems Understanding of Unix-like environments AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work Experience working in cross-functional agile teams Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders. Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously. A deep interest in game development is a plus. Based or willing to relocate in Paris Benefits Best-in-class compensation Other benefits according to the country you reside Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Solution Consulting team led by Jonathan, Director of Solution Consulting. The team consists of two Solution Consultants focused on Mirakl Connect, working alongside four Platform Consultants covering B2B customers across Southern Europe and the Middle East. Together, you'll be helping sellers successfully onboard and grow through the Mirakl Connect ecosystem.
 
About Mirakl Connect
Mirakl Connect is Mirakl’s ecosystem platform, connecting marketplace operators and sellers to simplify partnerships, onboarding, and growth. Trusted by leading brands such as Macy’s and Lacoste, Mirakl Connect helps sellers discover new marketplace opportunities while enabling marketplace teams to efficiently onboard and manage their seller ecosystem at scale.

 Your Impact

  • Guide new Connect customers through end-to-end onboarding — leading sessions, configuring accounts, and troubleshooting blockers in real time to drive fast and effective platform activation.
  • Equip Mirakl Platform clients to independently onboard their own sellers by providing training, clear documentation, and scalable enablement resources including webinars and live walkthroughs.
  • Develop deep expertise in Catalog Transformer — Mirakl's AI-based catalogue management product — and support sellers in troubleshooting and optimising their catalogues.
  • Track onboarding progress across your customer portfolio, maintain detailed records, and deliver structured feedback to continuously improve onboarding flows and the overall seller experience.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, and Data Science/AI teams to align on technical setup, surface insights from onboarding, and ensure guidance always reflects the latest platform capabilities.

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, customer support, or account management in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven track record of directly onboarding or educating customers on a new solution
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance or a related field; advanced degree is a plus
Skills:
  • Customer onboarding and hands-on enablement
  • Clear communication and presentation, including handling challenging customer interactions
  • Operational rigour

arbeitnow-homa-games-ai-unity-tools-engi.description: Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line. With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years. This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles. What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment. The opportunity As an AI Unity Tools Engineer, you'll build the next generation of QA automation and development tooling for Homa's games. This is a new, high-impact initiative, and you'll own it: from the first question to the tools running in production across our portfolio. You’ll work across AI, Unity, QA automation, DevOps, and infrastructure to make testing and build pipelines more reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient for games developed by Homa and its studios. You'll be working on AI-driven QA automation at the edge of what is technically possible, and you'll see the impact directly in the speed, reliability, and cost of how our games are made. What you'll do Build. Design and deploy AI-enabled QA automation pipelines across Homa's major Unity games. Run. Maintain and improve our TeamCity build pipelines and infrastructure so game builds stay reliable. Scale. Onboard new games and tools onto the platform without reducing service quality. Explore. Test AI-driven approaches to QA that cut manual testing effort and reduce reliance on costly legacy tooling. Drive adoption. Work with developers, QA teams, studios, and mobile teams so the tools you build are actually used. Measure. Track the impact of your work on testing time, build reliability, and cost, and turn it into clear recommendations. Requirements Ownership. You drive outcomes. When a build breaks or a test fails, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke. Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it. Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. You turn ambitious ideas into practical, achievable solutions. Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain a complex technical solution to developers, QA teams, and studios in a few sentences. AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of. Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this role as a chance to build something new and grow faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it. Bonus: you've built something. An internal tool, a testing framework, a game, a side project. We'd love to hear about it. For this role, you'll also bring Hands-on experience with Unity and the ability to understand Unity games, game systems, and testing contexts. Proven experience using AI systems, models, or AI-enabled engineering workflows in practice. Strong DevOps understanding, including TeamCity, build pipelines, and infrastructure. The ability to work across technical topics while understanding the wider product and business context. Experience working in a complex environment with meaningful product and testing volumes. Bonus points if you have: Experience building QA automation or testing frameworks. Experience with AI-driven exploratory testing. Experience in gaming or another Unity-based product environment. Experience supporting products with high testing volumes. Experience driving adoption of internal tools across multiple teams. Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Why Homa Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest. Real ownership, early. This is a new initiative. Your tools will change how Homa and its studios build and test games, and you'll see the results. A high talent bar. Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

What you'll do

We are looking for a Software Engineer FullStack to join the DOPE (Doctor Practice Evolution) team in the Clinical domain.

As a Software Engineer, you will help doctors create and deliver all types of prescriptions, covering the full lifecycle from drug prescription creation and renewal to medication search and paramedical care, across France and Germany. Team is also responsible for the creation of more than 2M prescriptions per week. 

You will work within a regulatory-heavy environment, collaborate with external drug database providers, and contribute to medication alert features based on patient profiles.

What you'll build

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to build features that deliver value to healthcare professionals and patients

  • Design and implement technical solutions ensuring performance, security, and usability across our fullstack applications (React, TypeScript, JVM ecosystem)

  • Contribute to code quality through reviews, testing, and continuous improvement of our development practices

  • Share your expertise and collaborate across teams to evolve Doctolib's architecture and technical standards

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

arbeitnow-doctolib-senior-ai-engineer-se.title: Senior AI Engineer - Search & Recommendation - Patient Team (x/f/m)
arbeitnow-doctolib-senior-ai-engineer-se.description:
Join our mission, join Doctolib! 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. 

The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing.

You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers).
  • Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML.
  • Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation.
  • Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later.
  • Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality
  • Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.
  • Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. 


Who you are

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you have:

  1. Production deployment: ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS)
  2. Strong analytical mindset: result-oriented,  patient-first approach
  3. Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. 
  4. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking,  reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR
  5. AI-engineering proficiency: turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch
  6. Architecture-first approach: you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling
  7. Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring
  8. Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel)
  • Additional ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference
  • Have experience with search engines or information retrieval concepts
  • Have exposure to learning-to-rank or feature engineering (for breaking ceilings later, alongside ML Engineers)
  • Have experience in a healthcare or other regulated domain (GDPR / HDS)

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.
  • We also invest in open, applied AI research. For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practical guide to learn more about how we bring deep AI research into practical healthcare applications.
Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
  • Free mental health and co

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you have:

  1. Production deployment: ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS)
  2. Strong analytical mindset: result-oriented,  patient-first approach
  3. Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. 
  4. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking,  reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR
  5. AI-engineering proficiency: turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch
  6. Architecture-first approach: you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling
  7. Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring
  8. Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel)

arbeitnow-eggai-it-operations-lead-banki.description: EggAI · Banking transformation programme (UK) · Remote, UK-facing — London for gate weeks About the Programme EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production. EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers. The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems. The Role Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what "ready to run in production" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold. The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. Agentic AI workloads need a different operating model, and you will shape it: redraw responsibilities between the client's teams and its managed service providers, set the standards each party works to, and lead the people through the change — so that those who run the platform today are ready and willing to run what comes next. This is a lead/principal position reporting to the Programme Plan and Execution Lead. It is remote, with regular London presence required for gate weeks and workshops. Responsibilities Reliability targets — set the SLO and error-budget framework alongside the client's existing structure, have the service owners adopt it, and commission the behavioural quality measures that do the same job for agentic workloads Observability and detection — define what Tier-1 services and agentic workloads must emit, including trajectory logging; require an automated path from a firing alert to the affected services and their owners; and hold the operating teams to closing the logging gaps in what runs today The incident and change path — set the runbook standard and its required coverage, extend incident classification and intervention mechanisms to agentic failure modes, and have rollback and change-failure rates measured and reported by those who own them Capacity and performance — direct the headroom position through the parallel-run peak at cutover, sponsor the chaos and game-day programme for payment rails and the core ledger, and mandate that capacity modelling covers inference workloads Gate evidence — own the technical content of the Operational Acceptance Report and Operational Readiness Certificate, the reliability section of each gate pack, and the reliability NFRs defended as ADRs through the client's Architecture Design Authority — written by the teams, reviewed and signed off by you The operating organisation — decide how responsibilities sit between the client's teams and its managed service providers for the new platform, and lead the people concerned through that change Expected experience 10+ years in leading IT operations teams — You have operated L1, L2, and L3 support as SRE, platform reliability or infrastructure organisations, with the people and the providers reporting to you Aligns operations with development, engineering and the business — has set operating goals that engineering teams and business stakeholders signed up to, and kept them focused on those goals through delivery Has introduced SLOs and error budgets into an organisation that did not have them, and can build on the experienced success factors Infrastructure in depth — has deep infrastructure knowledge, and what is required for smooth business operations: telemetry, redundancies, backups, etc. Incident management , with post-incident reviews that led to real changes in the system and in the organisation Regulated financial services , or another environment where an external body audits operational evidence. Has worked through a managed service provider and can set standards they do not personally execute Comfortable operating in a complex, multi-stakeholder programme where scope and ownership are still being established across parallel workstreams Valuable, not required LLM or agentic system operations: eval harnesses, drift detection, trajectory analysis, prompt and model versioning treated as change types Core banking or payments exposure, particularly scheme gateway integration What This Role Is Not Not a platform architect. A separate role owns agentic platform design and build Not an on-call engineer. You will not carry a client pager; out-of-hours operations are run by a third party Not a service delivery manager. This is engineering judgement applied to readiness, not ITSM process administration Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

arbeitnow-capco-managing-principal-softw.title: Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture H/F
arbeitnow-capco-managing-principal-softw.description:
Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture H/F

Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

 

Nous recherchons un(e) Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture pour piloter et développer notre expertise en software engineering, tout en accompagnant nos clients dans leurs transformations les plus complexes.

Ce rôle de leadership technologique, s'articule autour de trois dimensions essentielles : Engineering Leadership, Architecture & Transformation et Client Development.

En tant que Software Engineering Chapter Lead, vous définirez les orientations techniques, renforcerez les standards d'ingénierie et accompagnerez le développement de notre communauté de Tech Leads, d'architectes et d'ingénieurs seniors.

Vous aurez une forte proximité avec les technologies et la réalisation des projets, tout en collaborant avec les décideurs de haut niveau chez nos clients afin de structurer leurs transformations, d'influencer leurs choix technologiques et de développer de nouvelles opportunités pour Capco.

 

Ce que vous ferez

Engineering & Chapter Leadership

  • Piloter et développer notre communauté software engineering en définissant les standards, les principes et les bonnes pratiques.
  • Accompagner, coacher et faire monter en compétences les tech leads, les architectes et les ingénieurs seniors, tout en contribuant au développement des expertises.
  • Promouvoir une culture d'excellence en ingénierie, de responsabilisation technique et d'amélioration continue.

Hands-on Architecture & Engineering

  • Apporter une expertise technique approfondie et opérationnelle sur les technologies backend, notamment Java
  • Analyser en profondeur les architectures et les conceptions techniques, challenger les choix technologiques et orienter les équipes vers des solutions pragmatiques.
  • Accompagner les initiatives de modernisation technologique autour des architectures cloud-native, des systèmes distribués, des API, des microservices et des architectures événementielles (event-driven).
  • Garantir que les solutions répondent aux exigences de sécurité, de scalabilité, de résilience, de performance et d'observabilité.

Client Advisory & Business Development

  • Développer des relations de confiance avec les CTO, CIO, Heads of Engineering, Heads of Architecture et responsables Product de nos clients.
  • Challenger les approches de manière constructive et influencer les décisions stratégiques de nos clients.
  • Contribuer à l'élaboration des propositions commerciales et aux soutenances, notamment en définissant les approches, les architectures, les équipes et les modèles de delivery.
  • Participer au développement des offres et du portefeuille clients de Capco dans les domaines du Software Engineering, de l'Architecture, du Cloud et de la modernisation technologique.

 

Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes un(e) leader expérimenté(e) en ingénierie logicielle et en technologie, capable de conjuguer une expertise technique approfondie, une vision architecturale, des compétences en leadership et une forte orientation client.

Votre parcours peut notamment vous avoir amené(e) à occuper des fonctions de Principal Engineer, Principal Tech Lead, Engineering Lead, Software Architect ou Head of Engineering.

Vous disposez des compétences et expériences suivantes :

  • Une expérience confirmée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'ingénieurs seniors, de Tech Leads et/ou d'architectes.
  • Une expertise approfondie en conception logicielle, systèmes distribués, architectures cloud-native et pratiques modernes d'ingénierie. Notamment avec l’usage de l’IA appliqués au Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC).
  • D'excellentes compétences en communication, en français comme en anglais.

Une expérience dans les services financiers, le secteur bancaire ou les paiements constitue un atout.

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.

Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris.

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

 

Nos Marqueurs Distinctifs

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.
  • Un esprit “One Capco” Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

 

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  • Stratégie & Transformation
  • Finance, Risque & Conformité
  • Product, Innovation & Design
  • Data & Analytics
  • Conseil Tech (Advisory)
  • Engineering (Delivery)

 

Chez Capco, nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance
  • Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an
  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouve

Want to help solve the world's toughest problems with big data and AI? This is what we do every day at Databricks.

  • You will provide the industry insight and business creativity required to design and develop unique use cases and solutions that differentiate Databricks within the Pharma/Life-science segment.

  • You will build exceptional value with all engagements to guide successful negotiations to close

What we look for:

  • True sales leader with the following skills: accountability and ownership, sales execution, operational excellence.
  • Experience in direct sales of enterprise software platforms to large enterprises
  • Ownership of executive-level relationships with your clients
  • Extensive experience working with large, complex, regulated organisations
  • Knowledge of the Data + AI space with technology sales experience
  • Longevity with previous employers
  • Quota over-achievement and significant growth when selling complex software and services to Enterprise accounts
  • Experience driving successful adoption of usage-based subscription services (SaaS) and co-selling with AWS, Azure and Google Cloud teams
  • Methods for co-developing business cases and gaining support from C-level Executives
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies and process (e.g Territory and Account planning, MEDDPICC, Challenger Sales and Command of the Message)

  • Experience developing a clear partner strategy and implementing it to achieve success

arbeitnow-blp-digital-ag-legal-counsel.title: Legal Counsel
arbeitnow-blp-digital-ag-legal-counsel.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role You are BLP's first in-house lawyer. You build the legal function from scratch and protect a business that puts agentic AI into the ERP processes of 550+ enterprise customers. You report to the CFO and partner closely with Sales, Finance, People and Product, covering four entities in Switzerland, Germany, the UK and the US, with customers in 40+ countries. In your first 12 months, Sales runs on your contract playbook and standard templates, and BLP has a clear compliance framework for data protection and AI regulation. What you'll do · Own commercial contracting end-to-end: negotiate customer MSAs, DPAs and SLAs with enterprise procurement and legal teams, so deals close faster with risk you can explain to the CFO. · Build the legal toolkit: templates, a negotiation playbook with fallback positions and clear approval rules, so Sales can handle standard deals without escalating to you. · Lead data protection and AI compliance across GDPR, the Swiss FADP and the EU AI Act, and support security reviews and certifications, so enterprise customers trust how we handle their data. · Run corporate housekeeping for BLP Digital AG and its subsidiaries in Germany, the UK and the US: board and shareholder matters and cap table · Advise on employment law across our countries and protect our IP and trademarks, working with the People team on contracts, policies and equity plans. · Select and manage external counsel, deciding what stays in-house and what goes out. What you'll bring · You bring 7+ years of legal experience, including at least 3 years in-house at a B2B SaaS or tech company, ideally after training at a leading law firm. · You are admitted to the bar in Switzerland or another European jurisdiction and are comfortable advising on Swiss, EU, UK and US matters with appropriate external support. · You have personally negotiated enterprise SaaS contracts with large corporate customers and closed them on terms the business could live with. · You have hands-on GDPR and data protection experience and follow the EU AI Act closely. · You have built something from zero before: a template library, a contract process or a legal function, and you are happy to be the only lawyer in the room. · You are pragmatic and commercial in your approach. You give clear, risk-weighted advice in plain language, at the speed of a fast-growing company, in fluent English and German language. Strong plus · Experience with venture financing rounds, ESOP setups and/or M&A. · Background in ERP, finance automation or AI products. · Experience with ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits from the legal side. What you'll get · Founding ownership. You shape BLP's legal function from day one and decide how it scales. · Direct line to leadership. You report directly to the CFO and work with the leadership team on decisions that matter. · Global scope. Four entities, 40+ countries and enterprise customers give you breadth few in-house roles offer. · You work at the front line of AI regulation, applied to real enterprise processes. · You grow with the company and are set up to build and lead a team as legal needs expand. · You work from our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, with a team that values Impact, Transparency, Ownership and Excellence. · Competitive package. arbeitnow-benchling-strategic-account-ex.title: Strategic Account Executive (Zurich)
arbeitnow-benchling-strategic-account-ex.description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Strategic Account Executive to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business within your territory, focusing on building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across various personas within an account. You will play a crucial role in expanding our customer base and ensuring successful sales outcomes through effective pipeline generation and accurate sales forecasting. RESPONSIBILITIES Pipeline Generation: Creating 80% of your pipeline by identifying new business opportunities and engaging with multiple personas within the prospect/customer base. Utilize various strategies and tools to generate leads and move them through the sales cycle. Sales Forecasting: Develop and maintain accurate sales forecasts (+/- 10 of goal), leveraging data to inform decision-making and ensure predictable revenue outcomes with the goal of consistent attainment of revenue targets. Solution Selling: Effectively communicate the value of our platform, tailoring presentations and proposals to meet the specific needs of each prospect. Negotiation and Closing: Lead negotiations with potential clients, by thoughtfully addressing key stakeholders including multiple personas and CxO in the buyer journey, while navigating organizational complexities, addressing objections and securing new business agreements. Account Management: Work across multiple personas within an account to understand their unique needs and align Benchling’s solutions with their business objectives. Collaboration: Partner with internal teams (marketing, product, customer success, etc) and Channel to ensure a seamless experience for clients and drive long-term customer satisfaction. Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to maintain a competitive edge in the market. Process: Drive the sales process through Pipeline Generation (PG), 3 Why’s, Champion Building, MEDDICC, Command of the Message, etc. Maintain account integrity and opportunity data within company systems; Salesforce. QUALIFICATIONS You are drawn to our mission and you want to help Benchling win new business. You are committed to working in a collaborative environment, working together as a team. You have a love for working in a fast-paced environment and taking the initiative to get stuff done and try new things. You are passionate about powering new possibilities in biotech faster. Proven experience as an Account Executive, preferably within a data management, workflow SaaS or technology-driven environment that sells to multiple personas across IT & Line of business. Demonstrated ability to drive pipeline generation and manage complex sales cycles. Strong sales forecasting skills with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets. Demonstrated success in selling products or solutions that typically fall outside of pre-established budgets, with a proven ability to build a compelling business case and influence purchasing decisions. Experience working with diverse personas within an account (from technical decision makers, business decision makers & CxO execs), with the ability to influence decision-making at all the levels. Dynamic communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Self-motivated, with a strong drive to achieve and exceed goals. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment. Familiarity with MEDDICC sales methodology is a plus but not required. Knowledge of the life sciences industry, including: R&D, and/or IT functions is preferred but not required. Bachelor’s degree - life sciences major is preferred but not required. HOW WE WORK We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote #BI-Hybrid #BI-Remote Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.
  • Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics,  comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It,

arbeitnow-zurich-soft-robotics-gmbh-lead.title: Lead Software Engineer
arbeitnow-zurich-soft-robotics-gmbh-lead.description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. Our stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch Frontend: React, TypeScript Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB) DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana What we are looking for Required: Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar. Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems. Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems. Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS. Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader. Languages : English. German is a big plus. Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products. Availability : 100%, as soon as possible. Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position. Preferred: Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means. Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. Frontend: React and TypeScript. Mindset: Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself. Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you. Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter. Benefits Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work. Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company. Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days. Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out. The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one. Sounds like you? Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points: About you: A short description of yourself. Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences. Startup: Why do you fit a startup? Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together. Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
