Strong analytical skills, SQL is a must, and experience with reporting and dashboard tools such as Google Sheets, Omni, Tableau, or Power BI. Experience supporting commercial or account management teams with processes, tools, or performance tracking. Interest in AI, automation, and process improvement. Strong sense of Ownership & positive learning attitude are must-have Good organization & communication skills, and not afraid of writing structured documents English is no-brainers (fully professional capability in English). If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you! Please submit your CV in English. Hiring Process 1. Screening Interview - 45min 2. Live case study Hiring Manager - 60min 3. Stakeholder interview - 45min 4. Leadership Interview - 45min 4. Culture Fit Interview - 45min WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. arbeitnow-alma31-senior-account-performa.description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place: serving merchants and consumers.
Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.
As the buy now, pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.
With 380+ Almakers and more than €100M in ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!
 

👐 About the team

You'll join a team made up of one manager, one team lead and five Account Performance Managers: Mathieu, Guillaume, Hugo, Gonzague and Alexandre.
The team is responsible for supporting Alma's strategic merchants, helping them grow their business with Alma and ensuring that we continue to deliver value over time.
We're looking for our next Account Performance Manager to manage a portfolio of strategic accounts and play a key role in supporting our merchants' business strategies.
This is a permanent position based in Paris.
 

💼 About the role

As an Account Performance Manager, you'll manage a portfolio of approximately 200 strategic merchants, both online and offline. These merchants generate an average annual turnover of between €1M and €3M with Alma.
Most of your portfolio will be based in France, with some international accounts as Alma continues to expand across Europe.
Your role will be to understand each merchant's business, identify opportunities for growth, maximize the value of the partnership and anticipate any behavior that could lead to churn.
SMB and Mid-Market accounts represent around 40% of Alma's margin, which makes your work critical to the company's success.

Your main responsibilities

  • Drive merchant performance
    Build strong relationships with your portfolio through proactive outreach, including calls and emails. Use Alma's dashboards and performance data to identify opportunities and provide meaningful business insights.
  • Identify growth opportunities
    Analyze merchant activity and recommend initiatives such as:
    • Upselling Alma's solutions
    • Optimizing pricing and payment plans
    • Expanding into new countries
    • Activating additional networks or channels
    • Increasing Alma's share of the merchant's payment activity

arbeitnow-alma31-lifecycle-marketing-man.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
arbeitnow-alma31-lifecycle-marketing-man.description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

 

👐 About the team

Growth is part of the Revenue team. We build Alma's merchant acquisition engine: which merchants we target, how we find, identify and qualify them, how fast a qualified merchant reaches the right salesperson and, with lifecycle, how we convert, activate and retain them, in France and in our international markets.

We work AI-native, by design. Everyone in Growth works in Claude Code with a shared library of skills and connectors, a common repository that holds our workflow spec, our decision log and our merchant context, and a simple delivery lifecycle (Research → Spec → Plan → Build) where each stage ends with a human decision. Claude does the legwork; a person decides. Correctness comes from automated verification (tests, adversarial agent review, live validation), and every production change goes through a pull request with a named reviewer from DevX or SRE.

We are rebuilding our GTM system around five layers: market definition, signals, data & enrichment, decision & routing, and activation. As part of it, we are moving our merchant lifecycle off HubSpot to a modern customer engagement platform. Braze leads, Customer.io is in the running, and we want your view. You will lead that migration and the lifecycle programme built on top of it.

You will join a team of 6 with a Growth Ops, a Growth Engineer, a Paid Acquisition Manager, a Senior GTM Engineer (hiring) and an Experimentation & Tracking Engineer (hiring), and you will report to Julian, Team Lead Growth.

 

This position is a permanent contract (CDI) based in Paris, hybrid.

💼 About the job

Own the B2B lifecycle, from lead to active merchant

  • Design and run the journeys that drive revenue: lead nurturing, onboarding, activating signed merchants who haven't taken a first payment, retention and win-back.
  • Reach the right merchants at the right moment with the right message, using segments built on live data (industry, size, country, TPV, product usage).
  • Run a yearly campaign calendar (seasonal moments, product launches, credit upsell) next to the always-on journeys, with clear pressure rules. Start with email, then add in-app, POS materials for in-store merchants, and new channels when the data supports them.

Help drive Alma's move towards consumers

  • Alma is opening up to B2C, with new consumer products on the way. You'll be the first lifecycle person to work on it, and you'll get to invent how Alma talks to consumers.
  • It starts small next to the merchant work and is set to grow fast.

Lead the migration off HubSpot

  • Help pick the platform. Braze is the front-runner, and if you think Customer.io or another tool fits better, make the case.
  • Audit what runs today, decide what to rebuild, improve or drop, and plan the switch so no key communication stops along the way.
  • With the Growth Engineer and Data, define the data model, consent management and deliverability setup, then switch off HubSpot marketing on schedule.

Measure what you ship

  • Use control groups and A/B tests by default. Report on activations, reactivations and influenced TPV rather than open rates.
  • Build your own segments and analyses, and share what works with Sales, Account Management and Revenue Marketing.

Be the CRM project lead across Revenue

  • Align Sales, Account Management, Ops, Product Marketing, Brand and Legal on shared campaigns: you own the brief-to-delivery workflow, set the pace and arbitrate.
  • Make other teams autonomous on simple communications (templates, tone of voice, golden rules), so you can focus on the programmes that move revenue.

 

🗓️ Your first months

  • Months 1–3: you audit our current lifecycle (HubSpot workflows, onboarding emails, scattered tools), give your recommendation on the target platform and define its setup with the Growth Engineer, and keep priority campaigns running while you prepare the switch.
  • By month 6: onboarding, activation and retention journeys run on the new platform with control groups; HubSpot marketing is switched off; a yearly campaign calendar is shared with Sales, Account Management and Product Marketing.

🧰 You will work with

  • Lifecycle: Braze, Customer.io or equivalent (decision in progress). HubSpot until we switch it off.
  • Revenue systems & data: Salesforce (system of record), BigQuery, Looker
  • AI & delivery: Claude Code (skills, connectors), Notion, Linear

 

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • 5+ years in lifecycle, CRM or marketing automation, across both B2B and B2C. On the B2B side, you have run programmes hand in hand with Sales or Account Management on large portfolios (1,000+ accounts). On the B2C side, you have built consumer activation and engagement journeys at scale.
  • A campaign manager first: you turn a business goal into a segment, a timing and a message, and you can show the revenue impact of your past programmes.
  • Hands-on with a modern customer engagement platform: Braze, Customer.io, Iterable or equivalent. You build journeys, segments and personalisation yourself, and you have opinions on what each tool does well and where it falls short. Having led or contributed to a platform migration is a strong asset.
  • Data autonomy: you pull your own segments and results from a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), design tests with control groups, and understand how data flows between a CRM, a warehouse and a marketing platform.
  • Cross-functional leadership: you have owned projects involving seve

🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place: serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

You will join the Growth team and work closely with Revenue Operations, Account Managers, Business Analysts, Marketing, Data, and merchant technical teams. You will help Alma apply to its own website the experimentation and measurement expertise we bring to merchants.

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Paris, with a hybrid working model. Professional French and English are required.

💼 About the job

As an Experimentation & Tracking Engineer, you will own web experimentation at Alma: the A/B tests we run on merchant websites, the measurement of what happens on our own website, and its continued development following our recent redesign.

Your responsibilities will include:

Lead merchant experimentation from opportunity to readout

  • Qualify testing opportunities against technical and volume eligibility criteria, then design each test with the merchant: scenario, traffic split, pages, events, KPIs, duration, and stopping rule.
  • Implement variations and event tracking in Kameleoon, run the live phase, check data quality, and present the first results to the merchant alongside the Account Manager and Business Analysts.

Own web tracking and measurement quality

  • Define and maintain the tracking plan for Alma's website across 8 markets, implementing it through GTM, GA4, or equivalent tools.
  • Ensure reliable data flows into Salesforce, BigQuery, and Looker, while owning consent and GDPR compliance, deduplication, attribution, and reconciliation across sources.

Build and optimize almapay.com

  • Build and evolve landing pages, product pages, market pages, and local content following the website redesign.
  • Run a CRO programme on Alma's own funnels, starting with the demo request, while maintaining performance, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, and hreflang across markets.

Scale the experimentation practice

  • Turn the existing framework, documentation, and tooling into a repeatable practice, with a target of 8 merchant tests going live over the year.
  • Share standards, learnings, and results with Growth, Revenue Operations, Data, Marketing, Sales, and Product stakeholders.

🧰 You will work with

Kameleoon, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Salesforce, BigQuery, Looker, Looker Studio, Metabase, n8n, Make, Notion, Slack, GitHub.

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have 3 to 5 years of experience in experimentation, web analytics, CRO, or measurement-oriented web development.
  • You have hands-on experience with GTM and GA4, or equivalent tools, including consent mode, data quality, and debugging issues that can fail silently.
  • You are self-sufficient in JavaScript and HTML/CSS, including DOM manipulation, variation building, and debugging on websites you did not build and cannot fully control.
  • You understand the fundamentals of test validity, including sample size, stopping rules, and what makes an experiment result trustworthy. You are also comfortable working with clients and technical stakeholders in French and English.

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have an e-commerce or payments background, with familiarity with checkout journeys.
  • Can use SQL to pull and investigate your own data.
  • Have worked with Kameleoon, Optimizely, AB Tasty, VWO, or a similar experimentation platform.
  • Speak Spanish, Italian, or German.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity, and the ability to grow as much as experience.

🧘 What's in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

  • Owning a broad, high-impact scope as Alma's internal reference for experimentation and tracking, with the autonomy to shape the practice.
  • Seeing the direct business outcomes of your work: your tests inform how Alma wins and retains merchants, and your findings are presented to real customers.
  • Working across dozens of merchant websites, 8 markets, and several CMS platforms, while being supported by a central Data team and Business Analysts for deeper analysis.

🤑 Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma, including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and ClassPass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at a 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.

  • Mental health: free access to the MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year, plus additional paid leave for employees on executive contracts
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

  • Video call with the hiring manager from Revenue Operations & Growth to discuss t

Our team builds cost controls and governance tools that help Datadog’s enterprise customers manage data ingestion, reduce unwanted data, and prioritize the telemetry that delivers the most value.

Our scope spans multiple Datadog products, including Metrics, Events, Logs, and APM. As a backend engineering team, we partner with these product teams to address recurring customer challenges that create operational friction, increase costs, and contribute to churn.

arbeitnow-pennylane-sas-partner-account-.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Localisation et déplacements Poste basé à Paris , selon la politique hybride de Pennylane, avec des déplacements réguliers en France auprès des partenaires, de leurs équipes et lors d’événements professionnels. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager. Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ? Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant. Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action : Développer les comptes partenaires , en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell , en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence , grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant , en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain , en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur. Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes. Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes. Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles. Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu. 2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire. Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable. Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane. Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés. Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion. 3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires. Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe. Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau. Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation. Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats. 4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes. Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités. Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs. Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux. Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire. 5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales. arbeitnow-kaluza-product-manager-agent-e.description:
Product Manager - Agent Experience 

Location: Paris, France preferred, open to London applicants (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Team: Customer care
Salary: €46,000 – €55,000 / £47,000 – £59,000
Language: Fluency in French & English
Contract: Permanent 
Reporting To: Lead Product Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes.
  • Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced.
  • Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live.
  • Ensure Accessibility & Compliance: Champion EU accessibility regulations by design, translating regulatory and market-specific needs into actionable engineering requirements.
  • Engage Clients & Drive Value: Serve as the trusted expert for clients on agent experience, advocating for platform-first configuration over bespoke builds
  • Hands-on Delivery & Enablement: Maintain active involvement across the entire Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC)—from agent discovery sessions to feedback loops—and produce materials to support successful client adoption.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Contact Centre & UX Expertise: Deep experience owning end-to-end user journeys for high-frequency operational tools (e.g., agent desktops), with hands-on craft in user research, journey mapping, and usability testing with agents and supervisors.
  • EU Accessibility & Platform Integration: Strong working knowledge of EU accessibility standards alongside proven experience integrating products with complex third-party platforms and vendor ecosystems.
  • Client Delivery & Market Expansion: Successful track record implementing or localizing a product for external enterprise clients, taking solutions from zero to live through discovery, configuration, and change management.
  • Data-Informed Judgement & Influence: Demonstrated ability using operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, agent effort) to defend product decisions, coupled with a platform-first mindset that prioritizes existing capabilities over custom code.
  • Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop environments.
  • Prior experience within SaaS platforms, the energy sector, or large-scale utility migrations.
  • Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.
  • Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.
  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.
  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.
  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
    Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)
  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund
  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

We want the best people
We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We wan

arbeitnow-decathlontechnology-hris-lead-.title: HRIS - Lead Analytics Engineer (f/m/d)
arbeitnow-decathlontechnology-hris-lead-.description:
Lead Data Engineer - HR Data Migration (Workday) - People VF

Dans le cadre d'un remplacement en interne, nous recrutons un·e Lead Data Engineer, basé·e à Lille.

Nous souhaitons accélérer la transformation et la digitalisation de nos processus RH, en partie grâce à une forte maîtrise de nos données People et de leurs usages. Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous déployons une plateforme RH mondiale (Workday) qui intégrera un CORE RH et plusieurs modules de talent management pour les 65 pays dans lesquels Decathlon est implanté.

Votre mission : Au croisement de la stratégie et de l'exécution technique, vous serez le/la garant·e technique de la migration de nos données depuis nos systèmes legacy vers Workday. En tant que Lead Data Engineer, vous concevrez l'architecture de transformation, piloterez la création des pipelines de données, et mettrez en place un monitoring rigoureux pour assurer une migration "zéro défaut". Vous travaillerez sous la responsabilité du Program Leader et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes projet locales et globales.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

1. Architecture et Stratégie de Transformation des données :

  • Définir l'architecture technique et la stratégie de migration des données de nos systèmes sources (legacies) vers le template cible Workday.

  • Identifier le périmètre technique de la migration et concevoir des modèles de données répondant aux exigences fonctionnelles et de sécurité.

  • Documenter de manière précise les systèmes sources, les flux, et les règles de transformation complexes.

2. Ingénierie et Développement (Hands-on & Leadership) :

  • Concevoir, développer et superviser des pipelines de données robustes, évolutifs et sécurisés (ETL) pour extraire, transformer et charger les données locales vers la plateforme mondiale.

  • Définir et implémenter les règles de transformation avancées pour adapter nos données historiques aux standards stricts de l'intégrateur Workday.

  • Assurer l'intégrité, le chiffrage et la sécurité des données RH (données sensibles) tout au long du processus.

3. Monitoring des erreurs, Tests et Qualité des données :

  • Mettre en place les outils de monitoring des pipelines et de gestion des erreurs (alerting, logs) pour identifier, isoler et corriger les anomalies en temps réel lors des phases de tests et de "Go-Live".

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de contrôle qualité automatisés (Data Quality) pour garantir la conformité absolue des données migrées.

  • Coordonner les tests de migration (unitaires, intégration, fonctionnels) et organiser les activités de validation post-migration.

4. Leadership Technique et Coordination :

  • Piloter techniquement les ressources data impliquées dans la migration, animer les rituels techniques et garantir les délais et la qualité des livrables.

  • Maintenir une communication claire avec les parties prenantes (Data Stream Leader, équipes métiers, intégrateur externe), vulgariser les enjeux techniques et remonter les alertes avec des plans de mitigation.

CE DONT VOUS AUREZ BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

Expertise Technique (Stack Decathlon) :

  • Data Engineering & Architecture : Très forte maîtrise de la conception de pipelines de données (ETL, orchestration) et des architectures Data Warehouse (ex: AWS Redshift).

  • Bases de données : Maîtrise des bases de données relationnelles (PostgreSQL) et compréhension des bases NoSQL.

  • Développement & Qualité : Maîtrise des langages de programmation data, des pratiques CI/CD (GIT, Jenkins), de la conteneurisation et des tests logiciels.

  • Sécurité & Data Privacy : Solides connaissances en protection des données, chiffrage et conformité (RGPD).

  • Outils : Compréhension globale des systèmes d'information (ERP, HRIS, CRM) et idéalement une connaissance préalable des formats d'intégration Workday (un vrai plus).

Leadership et Savoir-être :

  • Expérience avérée dans le lead technique de projets de migration de données complexes.

  • Capacité à piloter, fédérer des équipes et interagir avec des profils très variés (techniques, fonctionnels, internationaux).

  • Esprit analytique poussé, culture du "problem-solving" et excellente gestion des priorités (gestion des risques et du temps).

  • Rigueur absolue (traitement de données critiques) et flexibilité dans un environnement mouvant.

Langues :

  • Français courant

  • Anglais courant indispensable (contexte international).

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows).

  • Équipe projet en local et partage avec le réseau mondial (parcours international).

  • Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, langages et technologies, certifications, events).

  • Formations internes et externes.

  • Actionnariat salarié.

  • Primes mensuelles et trimestrielles.

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire

arbeitnow-decathlontechnology-ai-enginee.description:
Dans le cadre de l’ouverture d’un poste en CDI, nous recrutons un.e AI engineer, basé-e au choix à Lille ou Paris.

 

🚀 CONTEXTE & ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES

Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe Finance Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer les métiers de la finance par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique.

Face à la fragmentation des analyses exécutées par la fonction FP&A, notre ambition est de construire des solutions plus standardisées avec l’appui de l’IA. Il s'agit d’implémenter des couches d'intelligence centralisées et agnostiques des outils, capable d'interagir avec l'ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, EPM, ...) pour faire évoluer nos interfaces d'une logique de consultation vers une logique d'action.

Dans ce cadre, nous développons des débriefs de performance financière générés par l’IA pour toutes les activités de l’entreprise. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable et sur laquelle ils peuvent prendre des décisions.

Déjà déployé avec succès en France, Espagne, Italie et Belgique, ce projet est le premier d’une série à venir.

Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e "Builder" : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.

 

 🎯 VOTRE MISSION

Nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer confirmé(e) pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de nos solutions d’IA pour les contrôleurs de gestion. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.

Pour relever ce défi, vous évoluerez au sein d'un collectif dédié, en collaboration directe avec d'autres AI Engineers et un Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximité vous permettra d'assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l'implémentation technique.

 

🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES 

  1. Développement Agentique & Fonctionnalités
  • Participer à l'extension des capacités de nos agents vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant notamment des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).
  • Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts, de la latence et de l'efficacité globale du système en lien avec les équipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.
  1. Qualité, Évaluation & Observabilité (LLMOps)
  • Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité de nos pipelines (Databricks / Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine).
  • Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des réponses et la vérification des citations pour garantir la traçabilité vers une source de vérité.
  • Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow, Langfuse).
  • Coder des évaluateurs automatiques pour itérer sereinement et prévenir les régressions avant chaque mise en production.
  • Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.
  1. Sécurité, Cloisonnement & Déploiement International
  • Isolation & Multi-tenancy : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de filtrage par métadonnées (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et/ou des modèles) pour assurer une étanchéité parfaite des données entre les différentes sociétés fiscales, entités légales et géographies de Decathlon.
  • Support Multilingue : Contribuer à l'architecture d'internationalisation de nos solutions en adaptant les pipelines, l'embedding et l'inférence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversité de langues.
  1. Produit & Impact Business
  • Aider à l'analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l'impact de nos produits
  • Traduire, avec l'appui de la Product Manager, les enjeux métier en comportements de modèles et en métriques de succès.

 

🧠 PROFIL RECHERCHE

Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d’une première expérience. 

  • Expérience : Profil confirmé justifiant de plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI Engineering, ML Engineering ou Software Engineering orienté IA. Vous justifiez également d'au moins une expérience concrète et réussie de mise en production d'un système GenAI ou agentique.
  • Stack Technique : Solide maîtrise de Python, de l'écosystème GCP / Vertex AI + Databricks, et des frameworks d'orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou Google ADK).
  • Expertise LLM & Agentique : Solide maîtrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avancée de métadonnées), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte/mémoire.
  • Qualité & Évaluation : Capacité à diagnostiquer une réponse incorrecte (problème de modèle, de retrieval ou de données) et appétence pour l'observabilité applicative (SQL / MLflow).
  • Langues : Français courant obligatoire & anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).

Les plus : 

  • Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.
  • Compréhension technique des enjeux de sécurité (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqués aux LLMs.
  • Connaissance des architectures microservices et conception d'APIs.

 

🎁 CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS

  • L'opportunité de développer un produit d'IA agentique de pointe avec un impact direct sur le quotidien des collaborateurs.
  • Un environnement technologique premium (Stack Google Cloud / Vertex AI / Databricks).
  • Une politique de télétravail flexible (2 jours par semaine en remote, le reste dans nos bureaux).
  • Une culture du delivery axée sur l'autonomie, l'intelligence collective et la montée en compétences (accompagnement par un Lead, certifications, formations).
  • Des avantages attractifs (primes mensuelles/trimestrielles, actionnariat salarié).

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions. Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide. Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains. Why SkyCell? 🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare. 🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation. 🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way. 💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell. 🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being. What You'll Do: Design and implement embedded firmware for low-power IoT devices using C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal) Integrate wireless communication technologies such as BLE, LoRa or Cellular Design, build and operate cloud-side ingestion pipelines and device fleet management systems for large-scale IoT deployments Contribute to the design and deployment of cloud architectures for IoT integrations Implement secure and reliable OTA update mechanisms for remote firmware management Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for firmware and cloud components (e.g. GitHub Actions) Collaborate with colleagues across firmware, hardware and cloud teams Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across device, connectivity and cloud layers Contribute to architecture and process improvements based on emerging best practices What You'll Bring: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal), with a good understanding of common interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART) Experience with wireless protocols (BLE, LoRa or Cellular) and IoT communication protocols and data formats (MQTT, HTTP/REST, CoAP, Protobuf, JSON) Experience designing and operating cloud-based ingestion and device fleet management systems for connected IoT devices at scale Experience implementing OTA updates in production systems Proficiency in a backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Node.js or Java) for device integration, automation and diagnostics, with excellent system-level debugging and problem-solving skills Good written and spoken German and English If you don't meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we'd still like to hear from you. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program. 👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave. 🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind. Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

  • Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

  • Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

  • Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

  • Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

  • Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

  • Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

  • Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

  • Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

  • Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

  • Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

  • Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

  • Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

  • Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8,

arbeitnow-banyansoftware-forward-deploye.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
arbeitnow-banyansoftware-forward-deploye.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Overview

We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Modernization Execution: Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.
  • AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling: Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.
  • Consultative Engineering & Change Management: Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.
  • Hands-on Software Development: Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.
  • Feedback Loop: Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.
  • Standards & Quality: Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.
  • Full Stack Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java).
  • Cloud Native & IaC: Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform.
  • Consulting & Change Management: Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices.
  • Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

Preferred Skills (A Plus)

  • Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization.
  • Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar.
  • Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda).

arbeitnow-lefebvre-sdu-ai-engineer-agent.title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
arbeitnow-lefebvre-sdu-ai-engineer-agent.description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. Strong experience in agentic AI. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. arbeitnow-globalizationpartners-field-ac.description:
About Us

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About the Role:

As a Field Account Executive, you will join a high-performing team laser-focused on taking over the market, building a world-class company, and solving the complex international expansion needs of thousands of employers.

In this full-cycle outbound role, you will lead the charge in driving new logo acquisition across the EMEA region. We are looking for relentless hunters who excel at multi-threaded deal execution, master modern prospecting frameworks, and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to maximize their impact. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a deep desire to win, this is your opportunity to build a high-growth sales career at the recognized leader in Employer of Record (EoR).

What you'll do:

  • Targeted Outbound Prospecting: Execute a sophisticated multi-channel prospecting motion (phone, email, social selling, video, etc.) to build a robust, high-quality pipeline across target EMEA accounts.
  • Multi-Threaded Engagement: Build strategic relationships across prospect organizations—from key operational champions up to economic buyers and C-level executives—aligning our solutions with their top-level business initiatives.
  • Deliver the G-P Value Proposition: Act as a domain expert on global hiring, articulating the strategic, financial, and operational benefits of G-P as the premier global Employer of Record (EoR) provider.
  • Full-Cycle Deal Execution: Lead complex sales cycles from initial cold outreach to discovery, solution mapping, commercial proposal generation, objection handling, and deal closure against monthly targets.
  • Rigorously Manage Pipeline: Maintain meticulous pipeline hygiene across all prospect stages, ensuring accurate forecasting and high-quality data management within Salesforce.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner closely with internal teams—including Sales Engineering, Legal, Marketing, Operations and Customer Success—to align resources, navigate complex deal requirements, and drive revenue.
  • Leverage AI for Maximum Impact: Intentionally integrate modern generative AI and sales tech tools into your daily workflow to research accounts, personalize outreach, automate workflows, and increase sales velocity.

What we're looking for:
Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, International Relations, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of sales experience, with 3+ years of proven success in a full-cycle, outbound-focused B2B sales role with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue quotas.
  • Outbound Mastery: Demonstrated ownership of an end-to-end multi-channel prospecting motion, with advanced skills in cold outreach and C-suite engagement.
  • Sales Methodologies: High competency and structured application of modern sales methodologies (e.g., Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, Challenger, Sandler, SPIN).
  • Tech Stack & AI Proficiency: Strong proficiency with Salesforce and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Hands-on experience leveraging modern Generative AI tools to enhance prospecting efficiency and workflow productivity.
  • Domain Experience: Deep understanding of B2B SaaS sales cycles, commercial negotiation, and complex buyer dynamics.
  • High-Impact Communicator: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to command attention, articulate complex value, and build immediate trust over video and phone.
  • Core Mindset & Drive: A strong desire to win, high coachability, a relentless growth mindset, and an authentic curiosity for solving complex customer problems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Domain Expertise: Prior experience selling within the HR Tech, Employer of Record (EoR), global payroll, or workforce management ecosystem.
  • Sales Intelligence Tools: Familiarity with modern revenue intelligence and tech stack tools (e.g., Gong, Clari, Cognism, Outreach).

arbeitnow-airwallex-staff-software-engin.description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. Read our operating principles to see it in full. You’ll design and build scalable backend services, REST APIs, event-driven systems and integration components within a microservices architecture, connecting with our React frontend. You’ll drive complex initiatives across payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, card networks and local payment methods, while partnering with product, business, infrastructure and external engineering teams to turn merchant needs into technical solutions. You’ll raise the engineering bar through architectural reviews, thoughtful approaches to technical debt, strong design practices, code quality, testing, observability, reliability and mentorship. Strong experience designing and operating high-volume distributed systems, preferably in payments, fintech, commerce or financial infrastructure. Recent hands-on experience with Java or Kotlin and Spring or Spring Boot. Expert experience building REST APIs, backend microservices, Kafka-based event streams and distributed data stores such as Cassandra, Hazelcast, Oracle Coherence or similar. Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, plus Docker and Kubernetes. Strong familiarity with observability and operational tooling such as New Relic, StatsD, ELK, Datadog, Prometheus or similar. A proven ability to lead projects from concept to production, with a focus on quality, testing, reliability and maintainability. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence across engineering, product and business stakeholders. Preferred Experience building payment gateways, acquiring platforms, issuing platforms or payment acceptance infrastructure. Experience integrating major card networks such as Visa and Mastercard. Experience with local payment methods such as iDEAL, Klarna, Trustly or similar. Familiarity with authorisation, capture, refunds, chargebacks, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, risk or PCI/compliance workflows. Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading cross-team technical initiatives. You'll thrive here if You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken. You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it. You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. The challenge is balancing performance, reliability, local complexity, and commercial outcomes in the same system, where small improvements can materially affect conversion and failures are immediately visible. You'll do well here if you're thoughtful, pragmatic, and motivated by making complex problems feel simple to customers. If you want to build the platform that makes payments work seamlessly for businesses around the world, this is the team at the center of that mission. arbeitnow-creativefabrica-senior-backend.description:
About Creative Fabrica

Creative Fabrica is a fast-growing AI platform that makes it easy for everyday consumers to create whatever they imagine, from images and videos to audio and 3D creations, using the latest generative AI models.

About the team: idea.ai

idea.ai is our bet on what creative software looks like when AI is the default, not a feature.

We built a single platform where anyone can generate and edit images, video, audio, 3D models, and vector graphics using state-of-the-art generative AI. Our tools serve hundreds of thousands of creators every day, from hobbyist crafters to professional designers and everything in between, all in one place.

We move fast, integrate frontier models into production-ready workflows, and build the infrastructure that gives creators every tool they need to turn any idea into professional-grade media, at scale.

About the role

As a Senior Backend Engineer (Go), you will be the architect of our multimodal generation pipeline. You won't just be building APIs; you’ll be designing the high-concurrency systems that orchestrate "heavy" AI workloads across any media domains. Your goal is to make complex, multi step AI generation feel instantaneous and reliable for a global audience of creators.

What you will do:

  • Orchestrate Multimodal Workflows: Design and scale Go-based microservices that manage the lifecycle of AI generations.
  • Performance Engineering: Optimize our ConnectRPC services and async processing pipelines (Kafka + SQS) to handle long-running, resource-intensive inference tasks without compromising platform stability.
  • Build the Creative Engine: Develop the backend logic for advanced features like multimodal orchestration.
  • Data & Infrastructure: Work with AWS to manage massive data throughput and integrate with high-performance storage and compute clusters.
  • Collaborate with AI Researchers: Bridge the gap between raw model outputs and a polished "One Person Studio" user experience.

What you will need:

  • Advanced Go Engineering: Extensive experience building and scaling Go services in high-traffic, high-volume SaaS environments.
  • Distributed Systems Mastery: Proven ability to design microservices that utilize asynchronous processing (Kafka & SQS) and low-latency communication (gRPC/ConnectRPC/GraphQL).
  • Cloud Architecture: Deep knowledge of AWS (EKS, S3, Lambda) and experience managing complex compute environments.
  • Product Rigor: A background in building professional-grade creative tools or media-heavy applications.
  • Software Best Practices: A quality-first mindset regarding code reviews, testing strategies, and observability.

Nice to have:

  • Media Processing Experience: Familiarity with handling varied media types (video transcoding, audio synthesis, vector manipulation).
  • AI Infrastructure: Experience with model serving at scale or managing GPU-accelerated workloads.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Experience in a fast-paced environment where you help define the product vision and iterate quickly.

Is this you?

Get in touch! We'd love to speak to you.

You can apply by clicking the "Apply now" button.

Creative Fabrica is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

arbeitnow-shiftbase-b-v-senior-data-engi.title: Senior Data Engineer
arbeitnow-shiftbase-b-v-senior-data-engi.description: Data Engineer Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them. Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet. You will build the foundation that fixes this. What you'll do Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it. Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production. Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team. Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent. Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io . Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today. Treat the warehouse like a product. Keep documentation, lineage, and discoverability current so departments trust the data assets, and handle sensitive HR and workforce data to GDPR standards. What success looks like in your first 3–6 months The warehouse has a real foundation. The first vertical slice, our accounts model, ships with tests and monitoring. You fully own the Dataform transform layer, creating capacity for semantic modeling and business-definition work Pipelines run against a defined freshness SLA, and you catch breaks before stakeholders do. Documentation and lineage cover what you own, and datasets that were stuck now flow to the teams that need them. What we're looking for You have built warehouse foundations yourself. You designed them rather than maintaining someone else's, with a track record in: Designing layered warehouse architectures (medallion, bronze-silver-gold) and dimensional models (star and snowflake) that teams reuse Advanced SQL as your daily working language Hands-on BigQuery, since our stack is GCP Building a SQL transform layer in Dataform, or strong dbt experience. ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads and real orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management Data quality, testing, freshness monitoring, and lineage built in from the start Python for pipeline code, scripting, automation, and API integration Reviewable, repeatable change through Git and PR-based deployment Nice to have, not required: another modern cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Redshift; managed ingestion such as Airbyte; preparing data for ML, LLM, and agentic use cases; and familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics and HR or workforce data. English is our working language, and Dutch is not required. This role isn't infrastructure engineering, ML or MLOps, or dashboard analysis. The Platform team owns infrastructure, the Product ML team owns ML, and the business teams own dashboards. It also isn't for someone who has only maintained a warehouse another person designed. You build the foundation properly, stay transparent about data quality and trade-offs, and treat the warehouse as a product for the whole company. arbeitnow-talk360-senior-voice-routing-s.title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
arbeitnow-talk360-senior-voice-routing-s.description: The Challenge We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next. A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow. Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling. This is a remote opportunity. What You'll Do Own call quality holistically : hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments. Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones. Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers. Work cross-functionally by design : partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users. Move routing toward automation : work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work. What You'll Bring Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience. NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD. Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus. Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts Who You Are Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix. Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it. A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team. Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked. Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach. Recruitment Process Recruiter screening Hiring manager screening with COO Technical interview Case study What you get Learning and growth €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. Time to recharge 25 vacation days Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview) Work from anywhere As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. A team you'll actually want to be part of Weekly team lunch every Thursday Regular team moments and outings An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond Set up for success Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance An environment to grow and make impact A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission About Talk360 Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build. Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business. As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products. Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.
