arbeitnow-mixpanel-senior-people-busines.description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the People and Culture Team

The Mixpanel People team exists to help every employee do their best work. We build the structure and support that enables a high-performing organization to move fast without losing what makes us Mixpanel - connection, candor, and the values we hold each other to.

A core driver of Mixpanel's success is investing in our people and clearing the way for individuals and teams of every background to reach their full potential. The People function leads that work - executing our people strategy, advising senior leadership, and running HR operations with the rigor a high-performing company demands.

Within that team, this role owns the EMEA go-to-market population specifically — three offices (London, Barcelona, and Tel Aviv) growing fast enough that the programs supporting them are still being built, not just maintained.

About the Role

This is a hybrid role based in London, supporting Mixpanel's EMEA business across our London, Barcelona, and Israel offices, embedded with our Go-To-Market leadership team. You'll report to our Global Head of HR Business Partners and operate as a strategic, trusted advisor to EMEA GTM leadership - shaping programs and policy, not just executing them.

This is a multi-country role by design. Your GTM population sits across the UK, Spain, and Israel, so working knowledge of employment law and practice in all three is essential - the right call in one market is often the wrong call in another. Experience supporting teams in APAC is a strong plus as our footprint there grows, but it isn't required.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary People Business Partner for Mixpanel's EMEA GTM leadership team, operating as a strategic, trusted advisor on org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy.
  • Proactively coach and partner with GTM people managers and leaders across EMEA to build, lead, and grow high-performing teams.
  • Lead complex, multi-country change initiatives — reorgs, comp cycles, policy rollouts — from strategy through communication, partnering with stakeholders to build buy-in rather than just announcing outcomes.
  • Investigate and resolve employee relations matters across the UK, Spain, and Israel, balancing legal risk, company principle, and individual dignity.
  • Turn workforce data — attrition, engagement, performance — into a business case leaders act on, not just a report they skim.
  • Collaborate with the broader People team on programs that elevate the employee experience company-wide, bringing an EMEA- and GTM-specific point of view to global design.
  • Maintain fluency in HR principles, practices, and regulatory environments across the UK, Spain, and Israel to recommend policy with confidence.
  • Build automation and AI into your own workflows and the team's — using it to move faster on the transactional work so there's more time for the judgment calls that need a person.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • 8+ years of experience in HR/People roles, including 5+ years as a dedicated People/HR Business Partner, ideally supporting Sales or go-to-market organizations.
  • Working knowledge of employment law and HR practice in the UK, Spain, & Israel — experience in all 3 regions preferred but required in UK & Spain.
  • Deep functional experience in two or more HR areas: talent management, employee relations, employee experience, compensation, organizational development, or HR policy.
  • A track record of leading through ambiguity and owning multi-country problems end to end.
  • Strong analytical and project management skills, with sound commercial judgment and empathy in equal measure.
  • Fluency with AI and automation tools, and a habit of using them to create efficiency in your own work rather than waiting for someone else to build the solution.
  • Excellent, direct communication — the kind that earns trust even in hard conversations.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience supporting APAC teams or navigating employment practice in other European markets.

#LI-Hybrid

Benefits and Perks

  • Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
  • Mental Wellness Benefit
  • Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

  • Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
  • Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
  • One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
  • Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
  • Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
  • Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

arbeitnow-trustly-senior-risk-assurance-.description: WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE ROLE We are building a dedicated Risk and Compliance Assurance function in the Second Line of Defence, and we are seeking a Senior Risk and Assurance Manager to own a single view of the second-line risk and control environment across Trustly's EU and UK regulated entities. As the Senior Risk and Assurance Manager, you will lead entity-level assurance and second-line risk oversight for Trustly’s EU and UK regulated entities, supported by the Global Enterprise Risk Management framework. This role will be part of a wider community of risk and assurance managers, which will also cover specific compliance domains (such as Financial Crimes Prevention, Safeguarding, Consumer Protection, ICT and Resilience). The focus of this role is the regulated entities in the UK and EU. You will confirm that domain testing reflects local requirements and local regulator expectations, and report findings to the entity Boards. You will serve as the primary point of contact for UK and EU regulators on risk and assurance matters. This role is suited to a seasoned assurance, compliance, and/or second-line risk professional with experience in regulated financial/payment institutions, ideally with experience of engaging with regulators. What you'll do Manage assurance at an entity level for Trustly’s EU and UK regulated entities, and be responsible for risk in these entities. Own a single view of the second-line control and risk environment across Trustly's EU and UK regulated entities, and contribute to standardised reporting including Key Risk Indicators and unified tracking. Confirm the local regulatory applicability of domain testing scope and methodology. Own the assurance opinion, reporting of findings, and the risk view to each entity Board and local management team, and support what the entity Compliance lead attests to. Contribute to the annual assurance planning through active engagement in an assurance forum, jointly reviewing and signing off scope with the relevant domain assurance managers. Serve as a primary point of contact toward the relevant EU and UK regulators/supervisors on risk and assurance matters, representing the function confidently and credibly. Support Internal Audit's reliance assessment by maintaining a transparent, evidenced audit trail per test, and document any risk-accepted changes to testing cadence. WHO YOU ARE 5+ years experience as a compliance assurance and/or second-line risk manager Payments sector experience preferred Experience engaging with EU and/or UK financial supervisory authorities is desired A confident and articulate approach, demonstrating an ability to represent the risk and assurance function credibly and build productive relationships across business teams, and to advise and collaborate with stakeholders at various levels, including senior management and Board members. Sound understanding of the EU and UK regulatory landscape relevant to payment institutions Ability to lead end-to-end assurance reviews; planning, scoping, reporting and issue validation, including knowledge of control testing methodologies, sampling, issue rating, and evidence standards. A firm grasp of the three-lines model and the independence boundary between second and third line, with the judgement to keep assurance independent. High attention to detail in the preparation of control findings and management-level documentation. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex concepts and present to senior leadership, Boards, and regulators. Willingness to work flexibly to collaborate with team members across different time zones. WHAT WE OFFER At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way. Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way. We are proud and committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and believe an open and inclusive environment enables people to do their best work. Our Fantastic Benefits (varies by location) 🌴 20 to 30 days of holiday to support a healthy work-life balance 🥳 Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues 👶 Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents ☕ On-site perks to make your workday smoother 💚 Well being support our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages, and much more to help you feel your best PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work-life experience! Shape Your Role and Make an Impact Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We’re looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation. arbeitnow-alan-people-ops-m-a-and-intern.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. The M&A and International Expansion role Alan is diversifying its activities in the fields of healthcare, prevention and insurance through mergers and acquisitions, and is actively expanding internationally. In addition, Alan recruits talent worldwide and enables its employees to work remotely in complete safety. “Alaner, everywhere”. The role makes sure each acquisition and each country opening is legally secure, fast and humane: from HR due diligence, to transferring employment contracts, to fully integrating the people who join us. You'll join the Expansion crew inside the People team. You'll work closely with the crew owner, and with Corporate, Finance, team Leads and General Managers involved in each deal. The People team The People team is made up of 13 people who work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every one of them is a genuine fan of our products (Culture being one of them) and deeply committed to Alan's Prevention and Health mission. The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, Comp and Ben, and now M&A and International Expansion. It is a generalist team: everyone shares three core missions, namely People on-call (answering the day to day questions from Alaners, which is now AI-powered), individual situation management, and HRBP responsibilities. This represents roughly 50% of our time. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: M&A and expansion. Your missions On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a very diverse range of high-impact topics: You will own to the People workstream of M&A transactions from due diligence to integration, alongside the crew and in close collaboration with the Corporate team, Legal, Finance and the business owners of each deal. Depending on the nature of the deal, you will own: HR due diligence: reviewing headcount, employment contracts, collective agreements, compensation & benefits, liabilities and risks of target companies, and flagging red flags clearly to the deal team; Transferring employment contracts in France and abroad, and choosing the right path for each deal and country; Integrating acquired teams: day-1 and first-months plans, harmonising contracts and benefits, communicating with acquired employees, onboarding them into Alan's way of working; You will support the people transition of acquired teams, working with the crew and leads on team set-up, keeping key talents, and supporting every individual situation with care; Working with external advisors (law firms, HR advisory, relocation and EoR providers): writing clear briefs and challenging their advice. Also: Opening new countries on the People side : entity vs employer of record, compliant local contracts, benefits and payroll partners You will handle international relocations and cross-border situations for Alaners moving or working between countries (visas, social security, tax, type of contract); Building reusable playbooks (HR due diligence checklist, integration playbook, "country opening – People" checklist) so each new deal is faster than the last Taking on global and cross-border individual situations (mobility, work from anywhere, sensitive cases) Raising the team's expertise : sharing your knowledge of employment law and M&A practices with the crew and the wider People team Leveraging AI and automation to multiply the impact of your work Outcomes within your first months in the team By 2.5 months: You are autonomous on day-to-day People on-call requests; You have mapped our current M&A and country-opening practices and shared a first list of gaps and quick wins; You have contributed to the People workstream of at least one live deal or country opening (due diligence, contract transfer or integration); You have contributed to our reusable playbook (e.g. HR due diligence checklist); You have shadowed and been reverse-shadowed on individual situation management. Is this what you are looking for? You may be a great fit for this role if: You have around 5 years of experience focused on HR M&A and integration topics, for example in a reputable HR advisory firm or in an HR team that focuses on these topics. You have worked on acquisitions in the Tech industry, not only on very large corporate groups, and you know the method is not the same. You master HR due diligence and the transfer of employment contracts. You have worked on post-merger integration, including talent density and parting ways, not only on the pre-signing side. You have international exposure: you have worked on deals or entities outside France. You are fluent in English, written and spoken (all of our internal processes, documentation and communications are in English). arbeitnow-legora-legal-engineer-tax-audi.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. It combines tax or audit expertise, product knowledge, client relationships and practical implementation. As a Legal Engineer in our Paris team, you’ll help tax and audit professionals put AI to work in their day-to-day practice. You’ll work with clients from the first demonstration through pilots, onboarding and wider adoption, understanding what they need and building workflows that hold up in real engagements. Some of what you’ll be doing: Understand the work. Work alongside Go-to-Market and Customer Success colleagues to demonstrate value, address objections and identify opportunities to expand adoption across teams and service lines. Help improve the product. Bring client needs and product gaps back to Product and Engineering with clear examples and enough evidence to act on. Make good work reusable. Your title and scope will reflect your experience and what you demonstrate during the hiring process. Vos missions Votre rôle Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite . Vous êtes à la fois : un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ; un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ; un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents. Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre. Vos principales missions 1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels. Votre périmètre couvre notamment : les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ; les systèmes de secours électrique ; les UPS / onduleurs ; les groupes électrogènes ; les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ; les systèmes de refroidissement ; la protection et la sécurité incendie ; les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées. Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations , et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques. 2 - Sécuriser les opérations L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques. À ce titre, vous : challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ; vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ; identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ; sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ; challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ; pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ; accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ; contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification. Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation , avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service. 3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites. Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels . Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : structurer les processus d'exploitation ; définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ; rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ; mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ; contrôler leur bonne application ; identifier les écarts entre les sites ; proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ; partager les bonnes pratiques ; réaliser des REX multisites ; accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards. La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique. 4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations. Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à : analyser techniquement l'incident ; identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ; apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ; challenger les analyses proposées ; accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ; contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ; participer à la résolution de l'incident ; organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites. Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle. 5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation. Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à : former et accompagner les équipes ; expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ; faire progresser les pratiques ; fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ; accompagner la conduite du changement ; favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites. Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct . 6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs Vous serez capable de : représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ; expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ; présenter les actions mises en œuvre ; répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ; apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures. Une organisation en construction Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré , regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets. L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation. Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec : les responsables de site ; les équipes Facility et Operations ; les équipes projets ; les experts techniques ; les prestataires et partenaires externes ; les fonctions transverses ; les clients majeurs. Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes . arbeitnow-kercia-solutions-un-e-chef-fe-.description: Notre entreprise Depuis 2007, Kercia est pionnier dans les technologies de vote électronique pour les élections professionnelles. Basée à Grenoble et Paris, notre équipe de 63 personnes accompagne plus de 5 000 organisations —PME, ETI et Grands Groupes — pour simplifier, sécuriser et réenchanter leurs processus électoraux. Kercia met à disposition une plateforme qui permet de gérer tous types d’élections avec des services adaptés à chaque organisation. Notre ambition : devenir le n°1 du vote électronique en France. KERCIA appuie sa stratégie de croissance sur le développement d’un environnement qui permet à tous « Les KERCIENS » de bénéficier d’une expérience salarié positive, individuellement et collectivement. Nous recherchons Un(e) Chef(fe) de Projets élections désireux de s’investir dans la réussite des objectifs de notre entreprise. En rejoignant la communauté des KERCIENS, tu participes à l’aventure d’une entreprise à taille humaine, qui saura t’accueillir avec bienveillance pour ce poste au sein du service opérationnel. Ton poste et tes missions Rattaché(e) au Manager opérationnel, tu assureras la réalisation de projets de vote électronique pour les clients en garantissant la tenue des délais, le respect des obligations légales et réglementaires et en optimisant la satisfaction du client. Tu seras basé(e) à Meylan, aux pieds des montagnes dans un bâtiment neuf au 5ième et dernier étage. Ce sont des espaces lumineux et modernes, avec une vuepanoramique à 360° sur les montagnes. Pour te repérer : https://share.google/8RQ9qsOwmtwZ1evCw Tu auras 3 jours/semaine possible de télétravail. Tu évolueras au sein d’une équipe de Chef(fe)s de projets, experte dans son domaine et passionnée par sa mission. Tes missions principales seront : D’assurer la réalisation des projets dans le respect des critères de qualité et dans un objectif de satisfaction client - Organiser les réunions de lancement avec les clients : - Proposer le planning établi en fonction des échéances du vote - Valider les points juridiques clés - Prendre en compte les attentes particulières du client - Réaliser le paramétrage de l’outil de vote électronique en s’assurant de la validation par le client - Piloter la réunion de scellement des urnes - Superviser le déroulement des élections et intervenir en support de 2eme niveau en cas de sollicitation - Animer la réunion de dépouillement des élections en rassurant sur la fiabilité du vote électronique - Réaliser un bilan du projet et envoyer un questionnaire de satisfaction au client - Organiser un point de débriefing avec le client pour les dossiers stratégiques De garantir le respect des obligations juridiques ou règlementaires particulières au projet - Recueillir auprès du client tous les documents d’entrée permettant d’évaluer les contraintes juridiques du client - Rédiger et fournir au client les notes/fiches juridiques nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet - Mettre en application les besoins juridiques du client (ex : échéances, sièges, quorum…) - Conseiller sur leur adaptation aux spécificités du projet et attentes du client - S’assurer de la prise en compte des règles juridiques (légales, conventionnelles) par le client tout au long du processus de vote De contribuer à la sécurité de l’information dans le cadre de tes missions Appliquer l’ensemble des politiques, procédures et bonnes pratiques de KERCIA en matière de sécurité de l’information dans tes activités de gestion de projets et de conseil juridique Veiller à la confidentialité, à l’intégrité et à la disponibilité des informations traitées (données électorales, données clients, documents juridiques, contrats, etc.) Signaler sans délai tout incident, suspicion d’incident ou non-conformité lié à la sécurité de l’information via les canaux internes prévus Participer, le cas échéant, aux actions de sensibilisation et d’amélioration continue en matière de sécurité de l’information (retours d’expérience, contribution à la FAQ interne, mise à jour de supports, etc.) Tu travailleras en synergie avec l’ensemble des services de KERCIA (commercial, technique, administratif, direction, …) et tu participeras à l’ensemble des ateliers et à la vie quotidienne de la communauté Kercienne. Tu génèreras de l’impact et de la satisfaction client au travers de tes missions. À ton intégration, tu suivras un cursus de formation interne aux méthodologies et aux standards de qualité KERCIA. Dès ton arrivée et tout au long de ta prise de poste, tu seras accompagné(e) par un membre de l’équipe. Partie intégrante du service opérationnel, le travail d’équipe et l’entraide sont au cœur des valeurs Kerciennes. Ton profil Tes atouts et toi De formation supérieure bac+2 (BTS / DUT) à bac+3/4 , tu as une forte appétence pour la gestion de projets et le conseil. Tu as acquis une expérience de 2 à 3 ans en Gestion des Ressources Humaines / Gestion de Projets ou Gestion Juridique (alternance incluse). Des connaissances en matière d’Elections Professionnelles seraient un plus et des compétences en matière de Relations Sociales / Gestion du Climat Social / Droit social sont recherchées pour répondre aux attentes du poste Diplomate, tu possèdes un bon relationnel, tu es reconnu(e) pour ton aisance orale et rédactionnelle. Tu es agile et autonome, doté(e) d’une bonne capacité d’organisation et de priorisation. Ton état d’esprit est orienté solutions. Tu sais faire preuve d’empathie et de bienveillance. Ton esprit de camaraderie et tes idées folles sont attendus sur ce poste ! Bonus : ton appétence pour les nouvelles technologies et ta maitrise du PACK OFFICE seraient un plus pour répondre pleinement aux attentes du poste. Mobile, tu seras amené(e) à te déplacer sur l’ensemble du territoire pour le compte de tes clients. Des réunions de coordinations régulières auront également lieu au siège à Meylan (38). Nous t’attendons pour une prise de poste à partir de novembre / décembre 2026. Poste à pourvoir en CDD 12 mois / prime qualité / tickets restaurant / intéressement / séminaire d’entreprise. À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap. Votre intégration chez Kercia : Dès votre premier jour, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour que vous soyez accueilli dans les meilleures conditions : votre poste de travail (PC, bureau ect.) est prêt et configuré, et un « Pack Welcome » vous attend. Pour faciliter vos débuts, un parrain dédié vous accompagne et des sessions « Vis-ma-Vie » sont organisées pour vous permettre de découvrir nos différents métiers. Chez Kercia, l'onboarding est un véritable parcours de plusieurs semaines conçu pour vous intégrer naturellement à l'équipe et vous accompagner dans vos nouvelles missions au sein d'un environnement attentif à l'épanouissement de chacun. arbeitnow-coreview-solution-implementati.description:
About CoreView  

CoreView is the global leader in Microsoft 365 (M365) tenant resilience, serving over 23 million users worldwide. We empower the world’s leading organizations to master the complexity of Microsoft M365.  Through robust security and precise governance, we help ensure that our client’s environments stay cyber-resilient and productive, no matter how complex they are.  
 
Our unified, cloud-native platform delivers powerful automation, rapid value, and end-to-end visibility across the entire M365 ecosystem. Backed by world-class support and a collaborative, innovative culture, CoreView is a place where your ideas matter, and your work truly impacts global enterprises.  

Please submit your CV in English

You must have eligibility to work in France without the need for sponsorship

Job Summary

As a Solution Implementation Consultant, you will be a key advisor and delivery expert for our clients, guiding them through the deployment, configuration, and ongoing evolution of the CoreView platform and associated Microsoft 365 environments. Your mission: ensure clients quickly achieve success and value realization, both through structured implementation projects and dynamic professional services requests.

In this role, you’ll blend strong technical skills on M365 and cloud administration with client-facing consulting excellence. You’ll lead customers through onboarding, tailored solution design, automation initiatives, and proactive optimization. You will act as the technical voice of the customer internally—focusing on removing friction, accelerating outcomes, and building trusted partnerships.

You will also be expected to progressively become a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on CoreView solutions and Microsoft 365, providing deep insights and thought leadership both internally and with clients.
 
Job Requirements
  • Technical Skillset: Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 (including Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive), SaaS/cloud operations, automation/orchestration tools, and security best practices.
  • Implementation Experience: Demonstrated experience delivering technical projects or professional services in a SaaS or IT consulting role. Experience with M365 tenant migrations, hybrid/cloud adoption, or large-scale IT transformations is highly valued.
  • Consultative Approach: Proven ability to capture business requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and educate customers at multiple levels—from IT admins to executives.
  • Project & Task Management: Aptitude for running multiple projects, prioritizing concurrent client demands, and maintaining detailed project documentation (SOWs, delivery plans, runbooks, reports, etc.).
  • Problem Solving: Strong analysis skills; able to diagnose issues, identify technical gaps, and design effective workarounds in fast-paced environments.
  • Teamwork: Comfortable collaborating across internal teams—working closely with product, support, engineering, and account management. Willing to share knowledge and continuously improve.
  • Communication: Excellent written and spoken English/French. Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and constructively to non-technical users.
  • Experience delivering on-demand or packaged professional services (such as tenant assessments, security posture reviews, policy automation, etc.), administering Microsoft 365 hybrid environments or complex customer deployments.


Extra Credit

  • Certifications: Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS-100/101, AZ-104, MS-500, etc.) or experience with ISO/SOC-compliant environments a plus.
  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or proven equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of automation, orchestration, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies.
  • Knowledge of scripting (PowerShell, KQL, etc.), workflow automation, custom reporting/dashboarding and proficiency with APIs in M365 contexts.
  • Familiarity with large-scale migration, change management, or digital transformation projects.
Job Responsibilities
  • Implementation Project Delivery: Lead clients through the onboarding, configuration, and rollout of CoreView (and satellite M365 environments). Own project execution (remotely and/or onsite), ensuring clear milestones, documentation, and mutual accountability.
  • Professional Services Execution: Deliver ad hoc and packaged professional services (e.g., policy setup, governance automation, reporting customization, security reviews, delegations, and optimization workshops) as scoped by client needs or internal recommendations.
  • Solution Design: Translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions leveraging the CoreView platform and best practices for Microsoft 365. Guide clients on technical architecture, integrations, and preferred operating models.

arbeitnow-avisia-data-engineer-h-f-paris.description: Nos missions : Nous intervenons chez nos clients sur des missions 100% data qui allient des dimensions techniques et stratégiques , où la donnée est le moteur de la performance opérationnelle . En tant que Data Engineer, vous êtes l'architecte qui rend la donnée exploitable. Selon votre profil, vous interviendrez sur la construction de plateformes data robustes (Data Lakehouse) ou sur l'industrialisation de flux complexes destinés à l'IA. Nos clients (Luxe, Retail, Télécom, Banque...) font face à une explosion des volumes et des sources de données. Votre rôle sera de garantir la fluidité, la qualité et la sécurité de ces flux. arbeitnow-avisia-ai-engineer-h-f-paris.description: AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ? AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital , créée en 2007. Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Data Engineering, IA générative et LLM. Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour faire de la Data un véritable levier de transformation. Nous intervenons auprès de clients aux secteurs d’activité variés, sur des missions qui combinent enjeux techniques, Data, IA et transformation opérationnelle. Selon votre profil et vos affinités, vous pourrez contribuer à des projets allant de la conception de prototypes jusqu’à la mise en production de solutions IA robustes, sécurisées et maintenables. Nos clients évoluent notamment dans les secteurs du Luxe, du Retail, des Télécoms, de la Banque, de l’Assurance et de l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques techniques variées. Quelques exemples de projets AI Engineer Conception et développement d’agents autonomes pour automatiser des processus métiers : conception de workflows complexes, notamment dans l’industrie ou la relation client, dans lesquels des agents IA enchaînent des tâches, prennent des décisions et interagissent avec les outils et les données internes de l’entreprise. Conception et orchestration de plateformes multi-agents : mise en place d’architectures dans lesquelles plusieurs agents IA spécialisés collaborent pour résoudre des problématiques complexes, par exemple en combinant recherche d’informations, synthèse et exécution de code, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle. Déploiement de plateformes Cloud : conception et déploiement d’environnements permettant de développer, sécuriser, superviser et faire évoluer des solutions IA. Évaluation, observabilité et gouvernance des solutions IA : mise en place de dispositifs permettant de suivre la qualité, les coûts, les performances et la sécurité des applications IA, afin d’en garantir la fiabilité et la pérennité. AI Engineer – Data & IA (H/F) Votre profil Nous recherchons un profil de formation supérieure (Bac+5) en informatique, ingénierie logicielle, data ou domaine équivalent. Vous justifiez de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en développement Data & IA, en data engineering, machine learning engineering ou conception de solutions IA. Vous disposez de solides bases en Python et en développement logiciel : APIs, Git, tests, conteneurisation et CI/CD. Vous avez déjà participé à des projets d’industrialisation de solutions IA, idéalement autour du RAG, des agents IA, des environnements Cloud et de la mise en production. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne autonome, pragmatique et curieuse, capable de comprendre un besoin métier pour le traduire en solution technique concrète. Une bonne maîtrise du français et un niveau d’anglais technique sont attendus. Votre rôle en tant qu’AI Engineer Chez AVISIA, vous interviendrez sur des problématiques techniques variées, de la conception jusqu’au déploiement de solutions IA en production. Selon votre expérience, vos compétences et les projets, vous pourrez notamment intervenir sur : L’analyse des besoins et la conception d’architectures IA adaptées aux enjeux métiers. Le développement d’agents IA, de workflows et d’applications RAG . L’intégration d’outils, d’APIs et de données d’entreprise. Le développement d’APIs, de serveurs MCP et de services backend. L’industrialisation et le déploiement de solutions dans des environnements Cloud. La mise en place de tests, d’évaluations, de dispositifs d’observabilité et de sécurité. La documentation des solutions et le partage des bonnes pratiques avec les équipes. Vous travaillerez en proximité avec les clients et les consultants AVISIA pour contribuer aux choix techniques, proposer des solutions pertinentes et faire progresser les expertises autour de l’IA générative. Les environnements techniques Pas besoin de maîtriser l’ensemble de ces technologies pour nous rejoindre ! Nous recherchons avant tout des profils solides en développement, curieux et motivés, avec l’envie d’apprendre et de monter en compétences sur les sujets d’IA générative, d’industrialisation et de Cloud. Selon vos compétences, vos envies et les projets sur lesquels vous interviendrez, vous pourrez être amené(e) à travailler avec différentes technologies : Langages & frameworks : Python, SQL, Node.js, FastAPI, LangChain, ADK, LlamaIndex, APIs d’IA générative (OpenAI, Anthropic…). DevOps & industrialisation : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git. Plateformes Data & Cloud : Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Dataiku. L’objectif : vous permettre de développer progressivement votre expertise, de découvrir de nouvelles technologies et de construire un parcours professionnel qui vous ressemble. Ce que nous vous offrons Chez AVISIA, nous accordons autant d’importance à votre évolution professionnelle qu’à votre épanouissement au quotidien. Un équilibre vie pro / vie perso , grâce à notre politique de télétravail. Une mutuelle familiale pour prendre soin de vous et de vos proches. Une formation continue via l’AVISIA School, pour développer vos compétences et rester à la pointe des technologies Data & IA. Des certifications pour valoriser votre expertise et accompagner votre montée en compétences. De réelles perspectives d’évolution : Contributeur, Senior, Tech Lead, Business Leader, Practice Leader… Plusieurs parcours sont possibles selon vos envies et vos ambitions. Un accompagnement de proximité , avec des échanges réguliers pour suivre vos projets et construire la suite de votre parcours. Le partage et l’intelligence collective , grâce à nos communautés d’experts, nos retours d’expérience et nos initiatives internes. Une culture d’entreprise conviviale et engagée , où l’humain compte autant que l’expertise technique. Le processus de recrutement Nous privilégions un processus structuré et transparent, pour vous permettre de découvrir AVISIA et de mieux comprendre les attentes du poste à chaque étape. Un premier échange avec notre équipe Talent Acquisition : un entretien téléphonique, en visio ou sur site pour échanger sur votre parcours, vos envies et notre environnement. Un test technique : un QCM et des cas pratiques vous seront envoyés par mail le soir même de votre entretien RH. Vous disposerez de 7 jours pour les réaliser. Un entretien technique : vous rencontrerez un consultant senior, un manager ou un Practice Leader, idéalement sur site, pour approfondir vos compétences et échanger sur les projets. Des échanges informels avec l’équipe pourront égale

arbeitnow-avisia-data-scientist-confirm-.description: AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ? Vous souhaitez donner du sens aux données et développer des modèles prédictifs qui répondent à des enjeux métiers concrets ? Rejoignez AVISIA et participez à des projets Data Science à forte valeur ajoutée ! Créée en 2007, AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital . Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering et Intelligence Artificielle . Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets stimulants pour faire de la donnée un véritable levier de transformation. Nous accompagnons des clients issus de secteurs variés, notamment le Luxe, le Retail, les Télécoms, la Banque, l’Assurance et l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques allant de l’analyse exploratoire des données à la conception, l’évaluation et l’industrialisation de modèles de Machine Learning. Nos missions en Data Science Chez AVISIA, nous vous proposons des missions qui allient expertise technique, Data Science et compréhension des enjeux business . Selon votre profil, vos compétences et vos affinités, vous pourrez intervenir sur des projets variés, de la conception de modèles prédictifs à leur déploiement en production, en passant par l’analyse des données et l’optimisation des performances. L’objectif : concevoir des solutions concrètes, exploiter pleinement le potentiel des données et contribuer directement à la prise de décision de nos clients. Quelques exemples de projets Data Science Prévision des ventes et du chiffre d’affaires : conception de modèles prédictifs pour anticiper le chiffre d’affaires généré sur le site e-commerce d’un acteur du Retail et améliorer la prise de décision. Systèmes de recommandation : développement et industrialisation d’un moteur de recommandation pour personnaliser l’expérience utilisateur et optimiser la conversion des visiteurs d’un site web. Prédiction de l’attrition client (Churn) : création de modèles de scoring pour identifier les clients présentant un risque de désengagement et permettre aux équipes métiers d’anticiper leurs actions de fidélisation. Segmentation client et ciblage marketing : mise en place de modèles de segmentation pour affiner les stratégies marketing et commerciales, personnaliser les campagnes et adapter les actions de fidélisation aux comportements et aux préférences des clients. Ces projets vous permettront de mobiliser des techniques de Machine Learning, de modélisation prédictive, de scoring et de segmentation client , tout en développant votre expertise sur des cas d’usage concrets à forte valeur ajoutée. Les qualités humaines Chez AVISIA, nous recherchons avant tout des talents curieux, impliqués et désireux de progresser. Vous vous reconnaissez dans les qualités suivantes ? Vous avez un excellent relationnel et appréciez le travail en équipe comme les échanges avec les clients. Vous aimez vous impliquer dans les projets et contribuer concrètement à la réussite des missions. Vous disposez d’un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, avec la capacité de prendre du recul sur les résultats obtenus. Vous êtes attentif(ve) à la qualité de vos livrables et savez présenter et vulgariser des résultats complexes auprès d’interlocuteurs non techniques. Vous êtes curieux(se), vous vous intéressez aux évolutions de la Data Science et du Machine Learning et aimez explorer de nouvelles approches. Vous avez envie de continuer à apprendre, de développer votre expertise et d’être acteur(trice) de votre progression professionnelle. Vous justifiez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en Data Science, Machine Learning ou modélisation statistique. Vos compétences techniques Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation supérieure spécialisée en Data Science, statistiques, mathématiques appliquées ou domaine équivalent, à l’université ou en école d’ingénieurs. Vous disposez des compétences suivantes : Vous connaissez les principales techniques de modélisation statistique et de Machine Learning : Random Forest, XGBoost, K-means, etc. Vous maîtrisez le SQL pour extraire, manipuler et analyser les données. Vous pratiquez Python, R et/ou SAS pour réaliser des analyses de données et développer des modèles prédictifs. Vous connaissez au moins une solution de traitement et d’analyse de données du marché, comme Dataiku, SAS ou Alteryx . Des connaissances des environnements Cloud, notamment Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS ou Azure , constituent un plus. Nous attachons autant d’importance à votre capacité à mobiliser vos compétences techniques qu’à votre compréhension des enjeux métiers. L’objectif est de concevoir des modèles pertinents, fiables et exploitables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients. Pourquoi nous rejoindre Chez AVISIA, nous accordons autant d’importance à votre évolution professionnelle qu’à votre épanouissement au quotidien. Un équilibre vie pro / vie perso , grâce à notre politique de télétravail. Une mutuelle familiale pour prendre soin de vous et de vos proches. Participate in conferences, standardization bodies and industry events to promote or lead discussions about the future of chiplet integration. Technical Leadership:Provide technical leadership and project management guidance to multidisciplinary teams. About the team: This role is part of the Product & system team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in Product & system and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success. About who you are: You’ve spent 5–10 years exploring the frontiers of 2.5D/3D packaging and heterogeneous integration, turning complex ideas into manufacturable systems. You have a deep understanding on the SoC physical design, TSVs, Redistribution Layers, hybrid bonding and how they are used at system level to implement chip IOs (Functional and power IOs) You are mastering Integrity 3D-IC Platform to define the chiplets interface, to define 3D stacking system, to generate the 3Dblox views, and to run all the 3D system level analysis (Power Delivery Network, Thermal, STA, LVS, SI/PI, …) You thrive where architecture meets technology — translating ambitious concepts into elegant, high-performance designs. Multi-physics isn’t just theory to you; you use thermal, electrical, and mechanical simulations to see the whole system clearly. You’re naturally collaborative — just as comfortable in technical deep dives as you are building bridges between design, process, and system teams. You’re the kind of engineer who balances vision with execution: leading projects, mentoring peers, and pushing boundaries with a calm hand. Above all, you’re curious — drawn to the challenge of building something new and meaningful at the intersection of memory, compute, and packaging innovation. Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities. Why Join Us: You will get the opportunity to work at the forefront of memory technology innovation. Vertical Compute is not only a state-of-the art but also a human adventure. We believe you must have a lot of fun developing the best of you. Making sure you and your team are going to enjoy the journey and become passionate about what we do is a key goal of our founders. You can be part of a talented and dedicated team in a fast-paced startup environment. In this role, you contribute to projects that will have a significant impact on the future of computing and electronics. You can count on a motivating total rewards package. Flexible ways of working. Join us in shaping the future of compute & memory technology — and celebrating success! Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

A collaborative team culture with regular social and sports activities. Real autonomy and short decision-making paths. Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Fullstack Web Developer to join our Web Apps team, in our Zürich office. In this role you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects.

The web apps team plays a central role at Auterion and owns the systems that add connectivity and remote interfaces for fleet management and operations. Our services are responsible for ingesting and analyzing flight telemetry data, managing and updating the fleet as well as integrating with other systems across the stack. 

The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Take ownership and drive the development of new features across all the team’s web based projects

  • Integrate services between edge devices and our centralized services
  • Handle new feature discovery, prototyping and investigations
  • Assist the Customer Success team in debugging and resolving customer issues
  • Monitor and analyze user usage patterns and other statistics
  • Push initiatives to clean up, upgrade, and refactor existing services to reduce technical debt
  • Maintain and improve integrations with 3rd party services

Qualifications and Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in a Fullstack web development or similar role.
  • Strong proficiency with the Node.js  ecosystem, development and tooling
  • Strong proficiency with the Typescript ecosystem, development and tooling
  • Strong proficiency with modern SPAs (Vue.js ecosystem preferred)
  • Solid experience with Postgres/SQL (queries, transactions, views, indexes, triggers) as well as ORM systems (Prisma)
  • Solid experience with Docker and container orchestration
  • Solid experience with CI/CD pipelines (GoCD and GH Actions)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Grafana)
  • Python proficiency is a plus
  • CH/EU citizenship required 

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

arbeitnow-point-one-navigation-network-c.description: Location: Zurich, Paris or Munich Language: Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English. About Us Point One Navigation is building the future of precise location. Our mission is to deliver a unified location platform that enables autonomy, safety, and efficiency across industries from robotics to transportation. We are a high-performance, high-collaboration team that thrives on solving complex problems, moving fast, and delivering impact. Role Outcome The Network Customer Support Engineer owns the customer support experience tied to the reliability, visibility, and operational health of Point One’s correction network. This is a player-coach role. You will personally handle complex technical support cases while also leading the operational systems, monitoring, and processes that ensure the network performs reliably at scale. Success in this role means: Potential customer facing issues are identified and addressed before they impact customers. When incidents do occur, they are resolved quickly with clear communication and strong root-cause analysis. The organization has clear visibility into network health, operational trends, and customer friction. A scalable network operations and support function is built as the company and network footprint grow. Immediate Areas of Focus Own the customer experience of our Network Work with our Network Operations team to understand incidents that affect the customer experience Identify emerging issues and collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams to understand and support the resolution of those issues. Understand available metrics and dashboards and contribute to the development of these tools to allow for the targeted resolution of customer questions. Deliver High-Quality Technical Support Liaison between Engineering, Network Operations and FAE and FDE team to support the customer. Personally manage high-impact or technically complex support cases. Partner closely with FAEs, Product, and Engineering to diagnose issues and close the loop with customers. Ensure customers receive clear, confident communication during investigations and incidents. Model best-in-class technical troubleshooting and customer engagement practices for the team. Build the Foundation for a Scalable Operations & Support Function Design and implement systems that enable both network operations and customer support to scale. Define a support ticket taxonomy that reflects customer use cases, technical complexity, and operational impact. Support Network Ops team on operational metrics such as: Network uptime and availability Incident response and resolution times Support response and resolution times Alert quality and monitoring coverage Document operational procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models. Develop automation and tooling to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency. Surface Operational and Customer Insights Identify patterns across support tickets, network events, and operational data. Translate operational signals into actionable insights for Product and Engineering. Ensure recurring issues and infrastructure gaps are clearly surfaced and prioritized. Create lightweight reporting that gives leadership visibility into network reliability, operational trends, and customer friction. Establish Visibility Into Customer Experience Define and implement the right metrics for understanding customer experience and operational impact. Establish mechanisms to collect structured customer feedback without creating noise. Use both operational data and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement. Coach and Develop the Operations & Support Function Act as a player-coach, leading through hands-on operational work while building the foundations of the team. Train and mentor support engineers on troubleshooting methodology, operational awareness, and customer communication. Establish clear expectations for technical depth, ownership, and responsiveness. Continuously raise the operational and support bar as the team grows. Qualifications Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English. Experience in a player-coach technical operations or support role where you owned both hands-on troubleshooting and operational systems. Strong technical background in GPS/GNSS, precise localization, geospatial infrastructure, or closely related domains (robotics, autonomy, embedded systems, positioning technologies). Experience operating or supporting distributed infrastructure or network-based systems. Demonstrated ability to build or significantly improve monitoring, alerting, and operational processes. Proven experience troubleshooting complex technical systems and working directly with customers. Experience conducting incident response and root cause analysis. Ability to define metrics, processes, and documentation without over-engineering. Comfort working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market teams in a fast-moving environment. Bias toward ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Our Cultural Foundation At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position. This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact . It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them. That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today , not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows. We think about our culture in two dimensions: How We Show Up Every Day These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate: Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting. High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us. Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles. No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together. Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust. arbeitnow-blp-digital-ag-senior-integrat.title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
arbeitnow-blp-digital-ag-senior-integrat.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations. What you’ll do Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability. Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers. Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them. Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers. Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up. Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations. What you'll bring Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user. Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC). NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0. JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors. A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching. Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us. A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role. Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region. Nice to have: Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite). Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP). Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD. Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor. Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope. Integration Engineer Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces. Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team. Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions. Senior Integration Engineer Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments. Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow. Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases. Why BLP Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live. Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards. Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares. Team: regular team events. Practical information Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe. If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich. Employment: full-time, permanent. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage. You'll work closely with the founders and the science team, and you'll have a direct impact on how the protein design and AI bio communities experience us. Run the Proteinbase community day-to-day: newsletter, competition updates, designer spotlights, and the Slack where participants and contributors gather. Own the participant-facing side of our open competitions and hackathons, from applicant communication and rules through to judging logistics and post-event recaps. Coordinate with the founders and the science team on what to post, what to amplify, and what to hold. What we're looking for 1-3 years running social, content, or community for a technical company, a science-adjacent media brand, an event series, or a community platform. Self-built audiences and adjacent experience count equally. A strong, distinctive writing voice. You move between LinkedIn announcements, customer replies, and community posts without defaulting to generic AI phrasing. Genuine curiosity about biology and AI. arbeitnow-adaptyv-software-engineer-lab-.title: Software Engineer, Lab Automation
arbeitnow-adaptyv-software-engineer-lab-.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role You'll build work-cell orchestration, instrument drivers, protocol scheduling, error-recovery logic, and monitoring. Physical systems fail in ways pure software doesn't — a plate gets stuck, a liquid handler skips a well, a temperature controller drifts. Your job is to make the system handle all of it gracefully. This is a broad, hands-on role for a strong engineer who wants their code to drive real machines and see it run the same day. What You'll Do Build orchestration software that coordinates liquid handlers, plate readers, incubators, and robot arms — handling timing dependencies, state, and error recovery. Reverse-engineer and develop instrument drivers and APIs. Each instrument speaks a different protocol (serial, USB, TCP/IP); you work out how it talks and build a clean abstraction over it. Model and execute complex multi-step protocols reliably — a single run can span dozens of steps across multiple instruments. Build error-recovery logic so that when something fails mid-run, the system retries, skips, alerts, or pauses depending on the failure mode. Create monitoring and observability for work-cell health: instrument status, run progress, error rates. Debug across the software–hardware boundary — figuring out whether bad data is a comms, firmware, calibration, or code problem. Work closely with lab automation engineers, the rest of the software team, and the scientists running production. Stack TypeScript and Python, Postgres (Supabase), Modal for compute. We control instruments with open-source Python tooling like PyLabRobot and PyHamilton wherever we can, rather than proprietary vendor GUIs. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering skills. You write production code in Python and/or TypeScript — well-structured and maintainable, not just prototypes. Comfortable at the hardware-software boundary. You've built software that drives physical devices, or you're excited to. You can read a protocol spec, debug a flaky connection, and reason about timing. Lab automation experience is a strong plus. Familiarity with PyHamilton, PyLabRobot, Opentrons, or similar tooling helps — as does a background in robotics, industrial automation, IoT, or embedded systems. Maker and hacker attitude. You like figuring out how closed systems work and building the thing that makes them work better. Bonus if you're comfortable with electronics, microcontrollers, or a 3D printer when an integration needs a physical fix. AI-native builder. It's 2026 — you build with coding agents like Claude Code as a default, and you have sharp judgment about what they produce. Self-starter and independent. You define what needs building from how the lab actually works, not just what's in the ticket. Reliability-minded. The lab runs 24/7; you design systems where one instrument failing doesn't cascade through the whole work cell. Biology background not required — but you should be excited that the code runs real experiments. Details Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site — you need hands-on access to physical instruments). Type: Full time Start date: ASAP Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

arbeitnow-centraal-bureau-voor-de-statis.description: Heb jij visie op identity platformen, werk je graag aan moderne authenticatieoplossingen en krijg je techniek én samenwerking in beweging? Reageer dan nu op deze vacature. Waar jij het verschil maakt Binnen het IAM Platform team van CBS zoeken we een engineer die wil bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige identity dienstverlening op basis van open standaarden en moderne platformtechnologie. In deze rol werk je aan de ontwikkeling, integratie en doorontwikkeling van ons IAM-platform. Je richt je op identity-componenten zoals Keycloak, federatie, authenticatieflows en koppelingen met applicaties en platformen. Daarbij combineer je platformdenken met engineering: je bouwt niet alleen mee aan een stabiele voorziening, maar zorgt ook dat deze verder automatiseert, beter integreert en makkelijker schaalbaar wordt. Je werkt aan een IAM-platform dat veilig, robuust en goed beheersbaar is. Je toekomstige collega's Je wordt onderdeel van het IAM Platform team van CBS. Dit team is pas opgericht en nog niet lang in deze samenstelling bij elkaar. Juist dat maakt deze fase interessant: je krijgt de kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuw team, aan de samenwerking binnen het team en aan de technische koers van het platform. Binnen het team werken collega’s aan verschillende onderdelen van het IAM-landschap, zoals Keycloak, PKI en cloud-native security. Samen bouwen jullie aan identity-diensten die een belangrijke bouwsteen vormen voor een veilige en toekomstbestendige IT-omgeving. In deze opbouwfase zijn samenwerking, eigenaarschap, kennisdeling en continu verbeteren extra belangrijk. Dit ben jij Je bent een engineer die techniek begrijpt én verder kijkt dan alleen de tooling. Je voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar ontwikkeling, integratie, beheer en afstemming samenkomen.
